The fifteen new ones are `Hide read receipts`, `Hide typing indicator`, `Send chat photos and videos at original quality`, `Clean up Facebook's chat list`, `Download any photo`, `Following feed on Home`, `Hide seen posts`, `Comment sheet options`, `Hide Meta AI comment summaries`, `Hide Meta upsells`, `Hide tab badges`, `Accent color`, `Keep the progress bar`, `Turn off auto-translation` and `Disable Play Store updates`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- The diagnostic report counts the reels whose player was already partway in when Facebook started them, and with Debug logging on it names the first twenty with how far in they were. That's for the reels that show time gone on their seekbar before they've played, and it works with `Tap to play` whether or not `Resume long videos` is in (issue #90).

- `Download any reel` also puts a Download row in a reel's More sheet, the one with Playback speed and Captions, right above Clear mode. Some accounts get reels without the sidebar the Download button sits in, so those reels had no way to save at all. The row saves the same way the button does (issue #18).

- New patch, `Download any photo`, with a switch under Downloads. Every photo you open full screen gets Save photo, even where the poster turned saving off, and a tap saves it to your Save folder at the biggest size Meta's servers offer, which is often bigger than the copy Facebook shows. It's saved as a JPEG like Facebook's own saves, even when the servers send that copy as AVIF, and on Android 11, which can't read AVIF, the largest regular copy goes instead. If Hushfacebook can't start the save, Facebook's own runs. It's in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on.

- New patch, `Hide typing indicator`, with two switches under Privacy. In a chat that opens inside Facebook, the person you're writing to doesn't see that you're typing, and people looking at a post don't see that you're writing a comment. Your messages and comments send as usual. It's off in Manager's default selection, and both switches start on once it's picked. The idea comes from HushMessenger's patch of the same name.

- New patch, `Hide read receipts`, with a switch under Privacy. In a chat that opens inside Facebook, the person who wrote to you doesn't see that you've read it. The chat can stay unread on this phone, and replying may still show you've read it. Like the other privacy patches, it's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once you pick it.

- `Hide tabs` has seven more switches under Appearance, for tabs Facebook gives only some accounts: Dating, Professional dashboard, Saved, Ad Center, Create, Explore and Jobs. They work like the others. Each starts off, a tab you pick leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts, and its page stays in the Menu. The Video tab already has its own switch in `Hide the Reels tab`.

- `Hide sponsored reels` also stops the query for extended ad breaks, the longer breaks a video can line up. It ran on its own path, outside the ad-break requests the patch already answers with no ad. The diagnostic report now counts every ad-break request the patch holds back, banners and video ad breaks included.

- `Hide posts by words` can also hide posts from people, Pages and sites you list. Turn on `Hide posts from people, Pages and sites` under News feed and add one per line to its list: a name as Facebook shows it, a profile or Page id or a Facebook link with one in it, or a site like example.com, which takes its subdomains too. A share of a listed author's post goes as well, and a link through Facebook's own redirect counts as the site it leads to. The list stays on the phone and goes into an exported settings file like the word lists.

- `Hide posts by words` takes patterns as well as words. A line between slashes, like /colou?r/, is a regular expression, and each one runs with a step limit so a bad pattern can't freeze the feed, and one whose repeats would take too long just to read is turned down. Save names the first line it can't read. Four new switches under News feed hide photo, video, link and colored background posts, and they all start off. A Page's video with a button under it, like Get tickets, counts as a video post.

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` has three more switches under News feed, for things Facebook puts between posts that aren't suggestions: Memories, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries, the row of friend requests, and the card showing where your friends are. Each starts off. Your Memories page and the requests under Friends stay either way.

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` also takes two more kinds of Facebook's own promotions, its social list prompt and the row of people to invite to a group. It goes by the type name each one carries, since some builds send them without a model class of their own. `Hide sponsored posts` also takes a carousel of several ads, whatever category Facebook files it under.

- `Hide Menu promotions` has a third switch under Menu, `Hide the Muse card`. The card at the top of the Menu that reads "Meet Muse, your personal AI agent." is Meta's ad for its AI agent app, and with the switch on Facebook treats it as if you'd tapped its Dismiss. It starts on.

- `Hide sponsored reels` also keeps the floating ad button off the comments of a reel or video ad that still gets through. Facebook's own comment buttons, like Message, stay.

- `Hide sponsored posts` keeps the floating ad button off a feed ad's comments too, on the post's own page and in the comment sheet. The Message, shop and visual search buttons stay. It works with or without `Hide sponsored reels`, and pausing Hushfacebook brings the button back.

- `Download any photo` has its own `Photo file name` under Downloads, next to the video's. It takes the same tokens, with `{photo_id}` for the photo's number on Facebook, and starts as `FB_IMG_{date}`, the name Facebook's own photo saves get. Export settings carries it.

- A `Save Facebook's notification sound` row under Notifications, in every build. It copies Facebook's own chime into the phone's Notifications folder so Android's sound picker lists it, for a notification category that came up as None after a fresh install, which no app can set back on its own (issue #83).

- `Turn off screen transitions` also covers tab strips inside a screen. A tap on one of Facebook's in-page tab rows, or on Feelings and Activities in the composer, shows that page at once. Stories, photo viewers and carousels move as before.

- With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report lists the last 50 Facebook screens that came to the front, by class, action and the link's host and path (never its query). When a tap opens the wrong screen, the report says which one it was.

- `Hide Stories tray` has a third switch, `Hide the composer row` under News feed, which starts off. It takes the "What's on your mind?" row off the top of Home, so the feed starts with the Stories tray (or your first post, with the tray hidden too). The create button in the top bar still starts a post, and a change shows the next time you pull down to refresh.

- `Hide sponsored reels` also covers the Reels tab on a profile or Page. That tab asks for its ads with a query of its own, outside the Reels ad pool the patch already holds, and now it doesn't send it, so the tab shows that profile's own reels. The diagnostic report counts each held query.

- `Hide Meta AI in the feed` also takes out the cards promoting Vibes, Meta AI's app of AI-made videos, that Facebook can put between posts. They go by the card's own type, like the Meta AI cards, and the report counts them under it.

- `Clean up Reels` can take out the Threads cards Facebook puts between reels. Turn on `Hide Threads cards between reels`, which starts off, and the next reel follows right after the last. The diagnostic report counts every kind of card it finds between reels, so a new kind shows up there (issue #85).

- `Tab bar at the bottom` has a second switch under Appearance, `Hide the tab bar while scrolling`. With the bar at the bottom, it slides away as you scroll the feed down and comes back when you scroll up. It turns on the version Facebook already gives some accounts, so the feed keeps its room for the bar. It starts off and needs a restart (issue #84).

- New patch, `Keep the progress bar`, with a switch under Playback. A reel's progress bar stays full size, so you can drag it without tapping the reel first, and a full-screen video's controls stay up until you tap, in the player that Enter fullscreen landscape mode opens too (issue #73).

- New patch, `Hide Meta AI comment summaries`, with a switch under Comments. Comment sheets open without Meta AI's summary at the top, and posts lose the summary under their buttons.

- `Clean up Reels` can open reels and videos in Facebook's own Clean mode, with the buttons down the side hidden. Turn on `Always use Clean mode`, which starts off, and you won't have to pick it from the menu on every reel (issue #75).

- In dark mode, `Material You theme` colours the selected tab in the tab bar, its icon and the line over it, with your wallpaper's accent (issue #65).

- New patch, `Hide Meta upsells`, with its own section in settings for Meta's other products. Its four switches start off: `Hide Edits promotions`, `Hide Threads cross-posting prompts`, `Hide Meta Verified offers` and `Hide avatar sticker promotions`. They cover the places outside the Menu where Facebook pushes those, like the Reels camera and the sheet after you post.

- `Stop Story auto-advance` has a second switch, `Loop stories`, which starts off. A story that finishes plays again from the start instead of stopping on its last frame, and a tap or a swipe still moves on.

- `Download any photo` has a second switch under Downloads, `Save photo in post menus`, which starts off. A photo post's three-dot menu gets Save photo, and an album gets Save all photos, which saves each one in turn.

- New patch, `Following feed on Home`, with a switch under Opening Facebook that starts off. With it on, Home asks for the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow, the feed the Feeds tab's All shows, instead of the ranked one. The Feeds tab's filters keep their own feeds, and the diagnostic report counts the ones it leaves alone by name.

- New patch, `Disable Play Store updates`, which starts off. Google Play stops offering Facebook updates, so you no longer need Morphe Patches as a second source just for that. It's Morphe's own patch with its notice kept, and Facebook still reads its real version (issue #46).

- `Block Instant Games ads` has a new switch under it, `Answer rewarded game ads as watched`, which starts off. With it on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched, so the game gives its reward while no ad is fetched or played. Interstitials and banners still get no ad.

- `Default playback quality` gives reels and video stories a quality of their own with `Reels quality` and `Stories quality`, and saves can go into a `Video subfolder` and `Photo subfolder` inside the save folder. Both start as before.

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` also takes rows of suggested shows under `Hide page suggestions and Facebook's own promos`, and posts Facebook files as injected or trending under `Hide "Suggested for you" posts`, as soon as Facebook serves one.

- New patch, `Hide tab badges`. `Hide the Home tab badge` and the switches beside it take the dot and count off Home, Friends, Marketplace, Notifications, Menu, Groups or any other tab, and `Hide the app icon count` keeps Facebook's count off its launcher icon. Notifications still come in. Every switch starts off.

- `AMOLED black theme`'s `Background colour` takes lighter colours like #5B513F now, with cards and menus stepped to match and secondary text and links lifted so they stay easy to read. (#34)

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the page under your last post takes the palette too instead of staying Facebook's grey.

- `Block background-return feed refresh` now keeps your place when you switch back to Home too, so the feed doesn't re-rank or reload behind your back. The `Keep feed position on return` switch covers it, and pull to refresh still works.

- New `Turn off auto-translation` shows posts and reel captions in the language they were written in. Turn on `Turn off auto-translation` under News feed, and posts Facebook would translate by itself keep their own text with its See translation link under them, while reels stop asking for a caption translation. It's in the default selection with its switch off, and turning it off or pausing Hushfacebook brings Facebook's translations back.

- `Keep the reel speed` has a second switch, `Keep the video speed`, under Reels and Watch. Turn it on and a playback speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's gear menu carries to the next videos you play, until you pick another or Facebook restarts. Reels keep their own speed, and ads, live videos, stories and videos in chats start at Facebook's speed. It starts off.

- A settings file now carries the Reels and Stories playback qualities and the video and photo subfolders. The import preview says what each will change, and an unknown quality or a subfolder with a path in it is refused.

- New `Comment sheet options` with three switches under Comments, all off to start. `Like only` stops a long press on Like from opening the reactions, so a tap just likes, and `Hide GIF and sticker buttons` takes them out of the comment box. With `Open every reply thread`, comments show their replies right away, the way they look after a tap on View replies. A `Hide reaction counts` row opens Facebook's own settings, where Reaction preferences lives. Pick the patch in Manager to get it.

- `Hide Meta upsells` has a new `Hide Meta AI's Imagine` switch, off to start. It takes the Imagine me button off posts and takes Imagine out of the post composer and the row of tools at the top of Create story.

- `Hide Meta upsells` has a new `Hide Threads in the share sheet` switch, off to start. The share sheet loses its Threads button and keeps every other way to share in the same order.

- `Download any video` has a new switch, `Offer to download copied links`, off to start. Come back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied and it asks once whether to download it. With the switch off, your clipboard is never read.

- `Hide Meta upsells` has a new `Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts` switch next to Hide Meta AI's Imagine. It takes the rest of Meta AI's buttons off posts, the business AI agent and visual search buttons included, along with Meta AI's deep dive under a caption. The post's next button shows instead if it has one. It starts off.

- `View stories anonymously` has a new `Mark as seen button` switch, off to start ([#88](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/issues/88)). With it on, each story gets an eye at the top. Tap it and you show up on that story's viewer list, while every other story stays hidden. Tap it again before you leave to take the mark back.

- New switch, `Lock Facebook`, under Privacy and off to start. Facebook asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when it starts and when you come back after the time you pick under Lock after. The black screen stays on top of Facebook's popups and tooltips, and Open and Share on a saved photo or video wait until you unlock. A reel in picture-in-picture keeps playing in its window without asking, but bringing it back or opening Facebook after that time asks, and a reply from a notification doesn't ask. Instant Games and their ads ask too, following the switch and the wait you pick even while they're already open, but a game opened soon after you unlock Facebook doesn't ask again. Pausing Hushfacebook or safe mode doesn't turn the lock off, and the diagnostic report says whether the lock can see every Facebook window on your phone.

- `Block promotional notifications` has new switches for group activity, event invites, live videos and reactions to your posts and comments. `Quiet hours`, a separate switch, blocks the kinds you picked only between two hours you choose (10 PM to 7 AM to start). Everything starts off, and messages and calls always come through.

- `Block background-return feed refresh` also keeps your place when Facebook would reload Home as you switch back to it after a while on another tab. The `Keep feed position on return` switch covers it, and pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts.

- `Hold a reel for 2x` has a new switch, `Only on the right edge`, off to start. With it on, only a hold on the right third of a reel plays it at 2x, and a hold anywhere else opens Facebook's long-press menu, even on accounts where Facebook has a 2x hold of its own on the reel's edges.

- `Text size` under Appearance makes Facebook's text 85% to 130% of what your phone's font size setting gives it. It starts at 100%, which is Facebook as it ships, and Pause puts it back. Restart Facebook after changing it.

- New patch, `Accent color`, left out of Manager's default selection. Pick Teal, Green, Purple, Pink, Orange, Red, Indigo or Amber under Appearance and the blue Facebook draws links, buttons, switches and the selected tab in takes that color. Blue text and icons on a card keep 4.5 to 1 contrast in whichever look the screen uses, light or dark. It starts on Facebook's blue. `Material You theme` wins when both are in, and the Accent color row greys out to say so.

- New patch, `Send chat photos and videos at original quality`, with a switch under Chats that starts off. Photos and videos you send from a chat that opens inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of shrunken copies. Photos lose their location and camera details (the rotation stays). A video with a location tag or a dashcam's GPS log (a gps box, NMEA text, Novatek freeGPS blocks or LigoGPS data) is still re-encoded, and so is one holding anything Hushfacebook can't read through, such as a camera maker's binary Exif box or an XMP packet. Videos from editing apps and Galaxy phones with no location in them go out as they are. One sent as it is keeps its recording date and the phone's make and model. Photos over 20 MB and videos over 25 MB are still shrunk.

- The `Words to hide` editor for `Hide posts by words` has an Add a topic pack button: Politics, Elections, Crypto, Sports, Celebrity gossip, Weight loss ads, and Giveaways and engagement bait. A pack adds its words as a few pattern lines you can edit, and they only match whole words, so a friend's "love you to the moon and back" stays put. It skips lines you already have and says what it added right in the editor, and nothing is kept until you save.

- `Hide posts by words` can also hide posts with a lot of reactions. Pick a count under `Hide posts with more reactions than`, from 1,000 to 100,000, and posts above it go. It starts on Off, and a post whose count can't be read stays.

- New patch, `Hide seen posts`, left out of Manager's default selection. Turn on `Hide posts you've already seen` under News feed and posts you've scrolled past stay out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days as you pick under `Keep them hidden for`. `Forget seen posts` starts over, with the switch on or off, and turning the switch off forgets the list too. The list is a short code per post and when you saw it, kept on your phone only, cleared of posts past their days and left out of exported settings.

- New patch, `Clean up Facebook's chat list`, for Chats that open inside Facebook. `Hide the notes and active now row` empties the list behind the row above your chats, so friends' notes and who's active go, and your own note tile may go too. `Hide chat list promotions` takes out the promotional banners at the top, like the one asking you to turn on notifications. Both switches start off.

- `Only the first reel waits`, a switch under Playback below `Tap to play` that starts off. With it on, the reel you land on in Reels still waits for a tap, and the reels you swipe to after you play it start on their own. The feed, Watch and stories keep waiting, and once anything waits again, like the feed trying a video or a reel coming back from another tab, so does the next reel (issue #91).

- `Slower speeds`, a switch under Reels and Watch that starts off. A reel's speed menu and the gear menu's Playback speed sheet on feed and Watch videos also offer 0.1x and 0.25x, slower than Facebook's 0.5x, for reading a sign or catching a detail that goes by too fast. The gear sheet writes the new speeds the way it writes its own, like 0,25x in German, and plays the speed you tap whatever language your phone is in. Keep the reel speed and Keep the video speed keep a slow speed you pick like any other (issue #95).

- `Facebook's Whitehat settings`, under Pause, backup and diagnostics, opens Facebook's own screen for security researchers when it's on the phone, and the Whitehat page on the web when it isn't.

- With Debug logging on, the report's Stories tray line is followed by a count of the other card types the tray kept, by Facebook's own type name, so a report shows which cards Hushfacebook doesn't sort yet. It never reads whose stories they are and doesn't change what the tray shows.

- With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report says which video formats Facebook's players were set up with: the codec, the size, and whether the picture is SDR or HDR (PQ or HLG), with or without HDR metadata. So a report shows whether a video was really served in HDR, with `Turn off HDR brightness` on or off. It's in every build, and nothing else from the video gets into the report (issues #93 and #66).

- With Debug logging on, a Save photo tap writes the sizes of the photo's copies to the report (just the sizes, never the image's address), so a report can show why a save came out smaller than expected.

- The report's Last screen left lines now say what each view on the way down paints behind itself (a colour, or the kind of drawable with its fill), so a report can show which part of a screen a theme missed. A sheet or dialog left open over the screen, like the comments, gets read first, and the walk also looks under an empty layer that paints nothing.

- With Debug logging on, the log names each colour token `Material You theme` leaves at one of Facebook's dark grays, once per token, so a report can show where the theme missed a gray (issue #37).

Fixes

- With `Use the system font` on, the bottoms of letters like y, g and p no longer get cut off in menus, captions and buttons on phones whose font draws lower than it says it does. Facebook lays its text out tight to the font's own measurements, which only fit Meta's font, so text in a font like that now gets the extra room Android's own apps give it (issue #96).

- `Hide sponsored reels` catches the reel ads that still showed in the Reels tab on 581 (issues #47 and #35). Facebook's newer Reels loader adds a reel on its own, or a page at the end of the list, and only tells the screen afterwards. The patch was taking the ad out of that message, so the report counted it as dropped while the ad stayed in the list. Now the ad never goes in. `Hide AI-detected posts` had the same gap for AI-labelled reels and gets the same fix. The report counts that message on its own line, Reels announcements, so the Reels pages line counts each reel once.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, a sheet or dialog that opens over a screen, like the comments, takes the palette on its plain dark gray backgrounds too, the comment rows and the Write a comment bar with its top border included (issue #37).

- `Hide affiliate product links` takes the other Shop now cards off reels too, like the one above the creator's name for a product of their own. Facebook sends products tagged on a reel, a creator's storefront and Shop similar as card kinds of their own, and the patch only caught the affiliate one. The diagnostic report counts each card it keeps out by its kind (issue #89).

- With `AMOLED theme` on, the Data mode banner that Flex carriers show under the top bar draws on the black page now, not as a dark grey band across it. Facebook paints that strip with a card's colour, and AMOLED had turned it a card's near black. The Buy data button keeps its own step above the black (issue #86).

- `Turn off HDR brightness` also answers no when Facebook checks whether the screen shows HDR. On a screen that shows HLG, that check is what lets Facebook brighten ordinary videos into HDR on Android 14 and newer, and it's also how Facebook picks a Dolby Vision video's HDR track. Until now the patch only held back Facebook's HDR window, which reaches a video drawn on a surface of its own from Android 15 on (issue #93).

- With `Tap to play` on, the reel you land on when you open the Reels tab waits for a tap again. Facebook 581 starts those reels the way it autoplays a feed video, so the tap on the tab counted as asking for it. Tap to play now checks whether the player holds a reel, and a feed video or a story you tap still starts as before.

- When Facebook closes with "Facebook keeps stopping", the next diagnostic report you export shows the error and where in the code it happened, with the last few events before it. Android only records that a crash happened, so a report sent afterwards couldn't say why. The crash stays on your phone, cleaned of addresses and ids, and goes in every report you export until a later crash replaces it or you tap Clear diagnostic data (issue #94).

Other changes

- `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers` also answers the seller page's flag when it's read by its number instead of its name. Facebook's React Native pages can ask for a flag either way, so a page that switches over keeps the button.

- `Picture-in-picture` now also covers a video playing in Facebook's full-screen Watch viewer or in the Video tab, using the window Facebook already has in both, behind the same `Picture-in-picture` switch. A paused video in the viewer doesn't open one, and in the Video tab Facebook still keeps ads and live videos out of it.

- With Debug logging on, opening Menu writes the parts of its layout that mention Muse or Get app to the log, so an exported report shows what the Muse card is made of. Only what's on screen is read, a parent component's own text is left out, and it stops once the card turns up.

- With Debug logging on, a long press on a reel does the same for every window Facebook shows a moment later, so a report also shows what the long-press menu's share row is made of, where Muse is listed first.

- With Debug logging and `Resume long videos` on, the log says where each reel was as it started, how long it is and where Facebook asked it to start, to help track down reels whose seekbar shows time gone before they play (issue #90).

- The README's list of patches that are off by default names all 32 again, `Hide Meta upsells`, `Hide read receipts` and `Hide typing indicator` included, and its notes on switches that start off no longer repeat themselves.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `581.0.0.45.58`. On most phones that's build `475215365`, which APKMirror labels (arm64-v8a) (320-640dpi) (Android 11+). Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475215364`, labelled (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+). Facebook `580.0.0.51.74`, build `475019344`, and `577.0.0.50.72`, build `474426275`, still work.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 2276 runtime tests and 820 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 85 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (both builds), 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.

This release gathers everything since v0.7.1 and brings 70 patches for Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, up from 60. 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work, and phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch 581 now too. The ten new ones are `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, `Turn off HDR brightness`, `Picture-in-picture`, `Turn off screen transitions`, `Turn off haptics`, `Block Instant Games ads`, `Hide tabs`, `Block screenshot detection`, `Allow screenshots` and `Hold back analytics uploads`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- New patch, `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, in the default selection with its switch under Marketplace. A seller's page in Marketplace has Facebook's own View profile button, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile, but Facebook only gives it to some accounts. Everyone else gets Follow, Message and More, with no way to check who's selling. With the switch on, every seller's page has View profile next to More and in the More sheet too (issue #68).

- New patch, `Turn off HDR brightness`, with its switch under Playback. Facebook turns the screen up for HDR videos and photos in the feed, stories and Reels, which flashes the screen brighter as you scroll past one. With the switch on they play in the screen's usual range at the same resolution, and on Android 15 and newer that covers videos Facebook plays on a surface of their own too. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. Off or paused, Facebook's HDR comes back from the next screen you open (issue #66).

- New patch, `Picture-in-picture`, with its switch under Playback. A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you go Home or switch apps. A paused reel doesn't open one, and after a swipe the window plays the reel you swiped to. It's the picture-in-picture Facebook already built for its Reels viewer, which it turns on for some accounts, so the window is Facebook's own. It needs Android 12 or later, it's off in Manager's default selection, and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook picture-in-picture patch. Checked on a phone with 581: a playing reel went on playing in the window after Home, a paused one opened no window, the reel a swipe brought up played in it, and with Tap to play on the reel being watched kept playing there.

- New patch, `Turn off screen transitions`, with its switch under Appearance. A tap on a tab or the Menu button shows that page at once instead of sliding to it, and a screen that opens over Facebook, like the post composer, appears and closes without its slide. Swiping between tabs still follows your finger. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on a tab, the Menu and the composer show at once, and with it off each slides in for about a quarter of a second as before.

- New patch, `Turn off haptics`, with its switch under Appearance. Facebook plays a short vibration on many of its own taps and gestures, and with the patch picked and its switch on, those don't play. Your keyboard, your phone's own haptics and a call's ring stay. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on the Menu button opens with no tick, and with it off the tick plays.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the feed, under News feed. It takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds to the feed between posts, by the card's own type, so people's posts stay whatever they say about AI. It starts on.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` also has a Hide AI character posts switch, right below that one. It takes out posts featuring one of Meta's AI characters, the Creator AI and AI Studio characters you can chat with, found by the attachment style Facebook draws a character with. Those are still someone's posts, so the switch starts off.

- Phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch Facebook 581.0.0.45.58. Pick its 32-bit build for Android 11 and newer, 475215364 on APKMirror. It keeps its code readable the way the 64-bit build does, and every patch applies to it.

- New patch, `Block Instant Games ads`, in the default selection with its switch under Menu. A game you play in Facebook that asks for an ad, whether a full-screen one, a rewarded one or a banner, is told there's none to show, the answer Facebook gives when it has no ad. So nothing is fetched or played, a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on. The idea comes from De-Vanced, which drops those asks.

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` also covers Marketplace's video ads. The two components that draw one in the feed draw nothing while the switch is on, and the ad's video isn't fetched. The diagnostic report counts them on its Marketplace ads line. The idea comes from De-Vanced's ad patch.

- New patch, `Hide tabs`, with a switch under Appearance for each of the Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming and Events tabs. Turn one on and that tab leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts. Its page stays in the Menu and opens there on a screen of its own, and a start tab set to it opens Home. Checked on a phone with 581, with Friends and Marketplace hidden and then brought back. It's in Manager's default selection with every switch off. The idea comes from Loukious, which hides the Marketplace and Games tabs.

- New patch, `Block screenshot detection`, under Privacy. Facebook watches for screenshots across the app, in the feed, Reels, chats, games, Marketplace and ads, and on Android 14 and newer it can ask Android to report screenshots and screen recordings. With the patch picked and its switch on, it never finds out, so whatever it would do about a screenshot doesn't happen. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on, screenshots taken in the feed and in Reels never reach Facebook's screenshot check, and with it off they do. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot detection patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Allow screenshots`, under Privacy. Facebook blocks screenshots and screen recordings on a few pages, which come out black. With the patch picked and its switch on, those pages show up in screenshots, recordings and the recent apps view like any other. A page that's already open changes the next time you open it. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Hold back analytics uploads`, under a new Privacy section. Facebook uploads how you use the app in the background, every three minutes while it's open, and runs Papaya jobs that train models on your phone and report back. With the patch picked and its switch on, the uploads don't start and the Papaya jobs end without running. It's off in Manager's default selection, its switch starts on once it's picked, and a change takes a restart of Facebook.

- With the Saved shortcut switch on, Facebook's Menu gets a Saved row at the end of Settings and privacy, right above Hushfacebook settings. It opens your saved items inside Facebook, and unlike the icon's long-press entry it shows on Samsung phones too. It comes with `Hushfacebook in the Menu`.

- Block account setup reminders, under Notifications, stops the "finish setting up your account" notifications some people keep getting while they're signed in. It starts off like the other notification switches, and login and security alerts still come through (issue #57).

Fixes

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` now covers a listing's details page. Its ad rows, "Ads inspired by your views", "Ads from sellers" and "Suggested ad products", come from requests of their own, and those aren't sent anymore. Checked on a phone with 581, the page keeps everything else, from the description and the seller to related items, groups and searches.

- With Save videos other apps can open on, reels and stories that Facebook sends only as AV1 or VP9 picture with xHE-AAC sound now save at their full resolution. Those used to drop to Facebook's own MP4, which for a story can be 360p. The phone now turns the picture into H.264 and the sound into AAC-LC before joining them, which takes a few seconds for a 1080p reel, and the file keeps the colors the original states (issue #77).

- Resume long videos works again for long videos opened full screen. Facebook 581 plays those in its reels viewer, which loops what it plays, so they were skipped as reels. A reel of two minutes or more now resumes like any other long video, and shorter reels still start from the beginning.

- Under Material You, a wallpaper palette with almost no color in its accent no longer turns unseen story rings the same gray as watched ones. Facebook's own blue now stands in for an accent that gray, so unseen rings, unread dots and badges stay easy to tell apart, while the palette still colors the grays. A palette with some color in its accent looks as it did. The diagnostic report's new Material You section gives the accent's chroma (issue #67).

- At large text sizes on narrow screens, the settings home title stays on one line and the empty search field keeps its whole hint visible. Back and Clear search retain their touch targets.

- With `Hide the Reels tab` on, the Reels row in Facebook's Menu opens Reels on a screen of its own. Checked on a phone with 581.

- Messenger and Instagram rows no longer say links open here when Android's link handling is off or the relevant address states are missing. The rows refresh together from one Android answer when you return from settings.

- Hide sponsored reels now stops Facebook's Reels and Watch ad pool from handing an ad out at all. A report from a phone running 0.7.1 with 581 showed the Reels tab's loader drawing an ad from that pool one slot at a time, with the page filter catching it only after the pool had marked it used and logged its position. The pool now answers the way it does when no slot is free, so the loader goes on with the next reel. Facebook isn't serving reel ads to the test accounts here, so this change is built from that report; the diagnostic report counts each ad held back (issues #47 and #35).

Other changes

- Hide the Stories tray no longer waits for Facebook to restart. Turn it on or off and the tray goes or comes back the next time you pull the feed down to refresh. Facebook now builds the tray while it's hidden so it can come back without a restart.

- Hushfacebook now builds on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Manager 1.33.0 carries patcher 1.15.0 and asks for an update before it'll load the bundle.

- Checked on a phone with 581: the reel Download button, its quality choices and the save notification's Cancel all have spoken labels for TalkBack, at normal and double font size. With Check for new Hushfacebook releases on, the daily check runs as Facebook starts.

- Checked on Facebook 577 with every patch: Keep feed position on return holds your place through seven minutes away, and with it off Facebook reloads the feed as it always has. Pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts. Pause, the automatic pause after three crashed starts, Marketplace's held ad rows, reel saves with Open and Share, and the diagnostic report all work there too.

- The settings overview shows the version and a short build identity with its source state. About and diagnostic reports retain the full identity. At large text sizes, Pause, Resume and Undo appear before the recovery guidance so they stay in view.

- Installation help explains Expert mode and how to identify overlapping Facebook patch sources. Bug reports now ask for every source's version and patch selection, including the details needed to diagnose issue #79.

Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work. Every patch applies to 581 without forcing anything, though three needed a new way to find their spot. Facebook's build tools moved some of the text they looked for out of the code that uses it and into shared lookup lists, so `Download any story` and `Hide Meta AI in search` now read those lists as well as the code. `Turn off double tap to like` finds the like's source wherever the call puts it, since 581 added callbacks after it.

Each time you leave a Facebook screen, it notes which kinds of views sit under two points at that screen's right edge, where a reel's buttons are, by class and resource name only. Nothing the screen says goes in. Reports from affected phones showed neither of the two sidebars the button goes into, so a report taken after leaving one of those reels (press Home while it's on screen, then open Hushfacebook settings and export) should show what draws their buttons instead.

- When Meta App Manager is on your phone and Facebook's web addresses don't open in Hushfacebook, a new **Meta App Manager** row under Supported links opens App Manager's link page (issue #30). App Manager comes preinstalled on many phones and Android verifies it for facebook.com, so the switches on Hushfacebook's own Open by default page kept turning themselves back off. Turn off Open supported links for App Manager, then select the addresses for Hushfacebook. Diagnostic reports now say whether App Manager is installed and enabled.

- New **Force dark mode** switch under Appearance keeps Facebook dark whatever its own Dark mode setting says (issue #64). Facebook's Settings page comes from its servers, and on some tablets it has no Dark mode row at all, so there was no way to turn it on. The switch starts off. Turn it on and restart Facebook, and both dark themes follow it too. Pause Hushfacebook and Facebook goes back to its own setting once it restarts. Export settings carries the switch.

- A copy made with Morphe's **Clone app** now installs next to the official Facebook (issue #60). With Clone app's **Update permissions** off, which is how it comes, the copy kept five of Facebook's own permission names, and Android won't let a second app signed with another key declare them. Hushfacebook now moves those under the copy's own name and points everything that asks for one at the moved name, the same way it already moved the copy's providers.

- With **Open on a chosen tab** set to Feeds, the new **Feeds opens on** row picks the filter the Feeds tab opens on: All, Favorites, Friends, Groups or Pages (issue #56). Hushfacebook asks the Feeds tab once, the first time it shows after Facebook starts from its icon, through the same route Facebook uses for a link to a filter. When your tab bar has no Feeds tab, Facebook opens Home, and the filter is picked the first time you open Feeds from the Menu. Every filter you tap after that stays as you tapped it, and a link to the Feeds tab still opens where it leads. Friends, Groups and Pages are only on the Feeds tab that opens on the most recent posts, so the usual Feeds tab opens as it always does for those. Export settings carries the choice, and an import refuses a filter this version doesn't know.

- **Words to hide** and **Words that keep a post** now hold up to 1,000 phrases each, up from 50 (issue #58). The two lists share 56 KB of room, enough for 1,000 short phrases in each, so they always fit in an exported settings file. The line under each editor says how full that room would be as you type. Save turns down a list with too many phrases, or one that would overfill the room, and leaves the editor open with everything you typed, so nothing gets cut off. An import whose lists wouldn't fit changes nothing. Each post's text is now read once, however long the lists are, where before every phrase was looked for on its own.

- Copied and saved diagnostic reports now include each declared domain's supported-link state, along with the link-handling permission, and say so plainly when a state isn't available. Unicode domain labels, including combining marks, survive only in their structured manifest-state lines. Visited URLs and other report data keep their privacy filters. Link ownership is read without changing it.

- The README's troubleshooting section now reflects the confirmed Media settings, WhatsApp-compatible saves and top-bar Reels results.

- Marketplace search now limits the size and depth of an answer before building its result tree. A large complete answer could bypass the old limit, and deeply nested data could exhaust the parser stack. When a limit is reached, its listings stay available and deferred fields still reach the correct result after an earlier ad was removed. Diagnostics count the reason without recording search content.

## Tooling

- The bundle is now built on Morphe patcher 1.15.0, the one Morphe Manager 1.33.0 ships, so Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer is required. Manager 1.32.0 turns the bundle down and asks you to update. Every patch applies the same way on Facebook 581, 580 and 577.

- Run the fixture checks of every patch on Facebook 581 as well. Where a build keeps a piece of text as a literal and another moves it into a lookup list (feed type names, Stories between posts, Messenger's link check), the tests accept either and check that the list really answers with that text.

- Check that every supported Facebook build still names Meta App Manager in its manifest's package queries. Facebook doesn't ask to see every app, so without that entry Android hides App Manager from it and the new row under Supported links would never show.

- Give the settings rows their own classes instead of borrowing the settings page's name, so code outside the settings package can't reach them and tests name them where they live. The page now keeps its Downloads section to itself. The translation check also reads a row helper called through the page's name, which it used to skip.

- Tighten how the system font patch spots a typeface compare. A static call on two objects now counts only when its own code does nothing but compare them, the way Kotlin's areEqual does, and any other call like that gets the picked font file. Both supported Facebook builds patch exactly as before.

- Stop the injected-register device check from clearing the log of a shared phone or emulator. It writes a line of its own to the log before dex2oat runs and counts only what comes after it, and it refuses the run when that line has already rolled out of the buffer. The fixture suite's fake ADB fails on any log clear and puts another run's lines ahead of the marker, so a tally that counts them fails too. It also puts another run's marker after this one, so a check that stops at any run's marker instead of its own fails as well.

- Review a new GPL Facebook Lite candidate, four forks and changed branch history. Shared Messenger compatibility constants now have a watch path. The 2026-10-02 census keeps historical and licensing restrictions and its public counts match the records.

- All 59 patches were verified on both supported Facebook builds with English, Arabic and Persian patcher locales. Each run passed the manifest, resource-table and injected-code checks, and every generated DEX matched the English run byte for byte. Existing instruction formatting already meets this requirement.

- Keep retired Facebook sources separate from active records while retaining their reachable historical code and license evidence. The census now checks whether a watched path still exists, so its deletion commit can't be mistaken for current Facebook code. A returning source or lost historical pin requires review.

- Enforce the real-codec test's subprocess deadline during execution. Temporary output files retain failure diagnostics without waiting for a pipe to close. Regression checks cover hanging tools, tracked descendants, nonzero exits and complete large output.

- Reuse expanded fixture DEX files between patch-anchor scans. The temporary cache checks the bundle's content hash and every reused DEX, refuses changed or corrupt bytes, and cleans up when the test worker exits. Existing checks still run on both exact Facebook builds.

- Align the Android test result-listener's HttpClient and HttpMime with 4.5.14. The compatibility gate rejects malformed URI authorities that the old parser routed to a host, while checking ordinary host selection and multipart report construction.

- Update the Android test transports to Netty 4.1.138.Final and Jetifier's settings dependency to JDOM2 2.0.6.1. Dependency changes now exercise both gRPC transports and the JDOM parser before a push, using the resolved artifact hashes. The shipping payload and Android plugin pairing stay the same.

- Record resolved settings-plugin, build and test dependency graphs separately from the payload SBOM. New release receipts bind the tooling report to their source and bundle, and publication refuses skipped audits, serious advisories and expired applicability reviews. Align Guava, Commons Lang and jose4j with their reviewed fixes.

## What's changed

* On PineDrama, Hushfeed's settings now tell you to restart PineDrama instead of TikTok. That covers the note under each switch, the restart button that shows up once you flip one, the saved message and the Feature Gate Lab, in English and all nine translations. Other mentions of TikTok, like its servers or the TikTok Sans font, stay as they are (#156).
* New `Hide spam comments` switch in Hushfeed settings > Comments, off by default (#187). It hides bot comments that send you to their profile or a "link in bio", spell out a website, hand out a Telegram or WhatsApp contact, or offer free followers. It knows the common phrasings in English and the languages Hushfeed's settings come in, plus French. Your own comments stay, and so do the creator's and any they pinned or liked, so a "part 2 in my bio" from the creator still shows.
* `Hide videos you have already seen` takes watched videos out of For You again (#172). TikTok reads each new page once before handing it to the feed. The switch sits that first read out, as it does on lists you open yourself, but everything the read kept was then remembered as allowed and never checked again. Now the page gets checked against what you've watched once TikTok hands it over, and your watch record starts loading during that first read so it's ready in time.
* With AMOLED dark theme, the `Add comment...` bar under a photo post you open from search, a profile or a link is black now (#171). TikTok leaves that bar see-through, and a photo runs on underneath it, so the photo showed through where a video post shows black.
* `Use an imported font` now works on PineDrama (#243). PineDrama doesn't carry TikTok's own fonts, so its text fell back to your phone's font and the imported one never got used. It now draws in your font at the weight the app asked for, so bold text stays bold.
* Feature Gate Lab's `Scrolling comments on videos` preset tells you before you apply it that comments only scroll on videos TikTok has turned them on for. Each video carries its own flag from TikTok's server, so most videos look the same with the preset on (#98).
* New `Allow photo comments` patch for PineDrama, with its switch off by default (#156). PineDrama hides the gallery tab in the comment box for everyone, even though TikTok's server allows photo comments. Turn the switch on in Hushfeed settings > Comments and restart, and the comment box asks the server like TikTok does.
* PineDrama moves to 47.5.3 and 47.4.3 is dropped, so grab the new PineDrama from APKMirror before you patch it again. Six more patches run on it now: `Advanced downloads`, `Automatic video advance`, `Hide inbox items`, `Hide profile shortcuts`, `Open the comments at full height` and `Show the progress bar`. PineDrama 47.5.3 has no stories, HD upload choice or foldable comment panel, so `Story controls`, `Always upload in HD` and `Foldable split comment view` are TikTok only now. That makes 95 patches Morphe Manager offers for PineDrama. The rest lean on TikTok's LIVE rooms, feed buttons or resources that PineDrama doesn't have (#156).
* New `Report a newer phone to effects` switch, off by default (#176). Effects ask TikTok's server whether your phone can run them, and on some older phones the answer is "This effect doesn't work on this device". With the switch on, the effects server is told you have a Galaxy S24 Ultra. Sign-in and everything else still see your real phone. An effect your phone really can't run may still fail or look wrong.
* New `Load all saved stickers` patch, with no switch. PineDrama's sticker panel loaded only the first 100 stickers you saved and never asked for more, so the rest were missing from Saved. It now asks for all of them in one go. TikTok gets the same first request, and it still loads more by itself past that (#214).
* New `LIVE recording source` choice under `Record LIVEs you watch`. `Stream only` saves the room's own video like before. `Screen` records what your phone shows while you watch. Android asks to allow screen recording each time, and Stop saves it. The app's sound comes along when TikTok has the microphone permission, otherwise the recording is video only (#37).
* New `Blur the video behind the bar` switch under `Liquid glass look`. It frosts the glass pill with a soft blur of the video behind it, off by default, on Android 12 and up (#231).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the light pieces left in a LIVE room go dark too. The navigation bar under the menu a long press in a room opens stays dark now, even when TikTok turns it light again. The tiles in the host's profile card and the fan club's tab strip and card turn dark, and the text and icons on them turn light so they stay readable (#159).
* `Tag saved videos with their details` now tags the videos TikTok actually sends. Their files carry a short list of TikTok's own fields where the tags go, and the switch left those files alone, so every save came out with no title, creator, date or link. The tags go in now, and TikTok's fields stay in the file beside them.
* `Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button` also hides the Auto scroll switch that tablets and unfolded foldables show beside the avatar on each video, and it works with `Auto-advance videos` off now. Before, that switch stayed, and the hide only worked while Auto-advance was on (#234).
* The README's install steps now say which 47.5.3 file to get. Morphe Manager on a phone should patch the bundle (`.apkm`), because on a device with 3 GB Manager ran out of memory on the APK and patched the bundle in about a minute. A computer should patch the APK. The out of memory tip under Patching stalls partway points to the bundle too, and step 6 says to uninstall the Google Play TikTok first, which logs you out.
* With `Keep Clear display across videos` off, the tabs, the caption and the buttons now come back as your swipe lets go, so the next video arrives with them. Before, it settled full screen first and then jumped when they showed up again. A Clear display you turn on from TikTok's long-press menu also stays on now instead of switching itself off as the menu closes (#232).
* With `See-through bottom bar` on, the caption, the buttons and the search bar don't drop down over the tabs for a moment after each swipe anymore (#232).
* Long press set to `Save the frame on screen as a photo` works again on 47.5.3. TikTok's player now draws each video into a layer of its own under the feed, so the save only found an empty view and said the frame couldn't be read. It reads the player's layer now, and the photo comes out at the video's own size with no caption or buttons, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile.
* `Remove feed ads` also takes out the smaller Lemon8 card in For You, the one titled "Your daily dose of inspiration" with a Lemon8 post and Open Lemon8 under it. It's built differently from the full-screen Lemon8 card the switch already removed, so it slipped through on 47.5.3.
* The `Show how many were filtered` label and the `Show what is left of the budget` label stay off the Shop tab and the Nearby tab now. Both showed there because the Home tab stays selected on those tabs, and the filtered count sat right over their search boxes. They still show on For You and Following.

* The README says how much memory morphe-desktop needs on a computer. With every patch picked on 47.5.3 it runs out at 1 GB, Java's default on a 4 GB machine, and finishes at 1.5 GB, so start it with `java -Xmx2g` (#220).
* With `Double tap` set to `Do nothing`, or every corner of `Double tap by corner` set to it, a tap on a video pauses or plays the moment your finger lifts. TikTok used to hold each tap for a beat in case a second one followed, and two quick taps counted as a double tap that did nothing. Now each one counts (#239).

* `Glass lens on the current tab` slides to the next tab even after you've sat on one tab for a while, or when TikTok takes a moment to open a tab for the first time. Before, it only slid when you tapped quickly, and in both of those cases it jumped instead (#231).
* With `Automatic Clear display` on, a search result you open again from TikTok's own search clears again, even when you brought its buttons back by hand the last time you watched it. Before, it remembered that and stayed uncleared (#84).
* `LIVE recording quality` also offers the presets from a LIVE room's own quality menu: Original, 1080p, 720p, 540p and 360p. If the room doesn't have the one you picked, the recording takes the closest one below it, or the closest above when nothing lower is there. A room's 60 fps streams count as the quality they're in, so 1080p in a 1080p60 room records the 60 fps stream instead of falling back to 720p (#203).
* When the Download quality list stops below 720p, it now also offers the video's own H.264 or HEVC version if that one is taller. The diagnostic report has a new section for the last video you opened the list on, with each quality it offered and why any others were left out (#240).
* `Show where commenters are from` finds a country more often. It remembers someone's country from their earlier comments and from videos of theirs you scrolled past, and it reads one more of the country fields TikTok sends with an account (#201).
* `Latest first` on the Following tab now keeps everything below the video you're watching in date order as more posts load. A newer post that shows up late moves up right after your video, and nothing you've already scrolled past moves. It also asks TikTok for twice as many posts on the first load, so a newer post is less likely to turn up after the first video is already playing. When TikTok opens fresh, it no longer starts the Following tab on the post it saved from last time, which was usually older than everything loading under it. The first video now comes from the new, sorted list (#226).
* Sorting a profile or Liked grid now has Least viewed first and Least liked first. While an order is on, the grid keeps loading by itself (up to 300 videos) so the order covers more than the first screen, and a button in the grid's corner changes the order right there. When you open a video from a sorted grid, swiping up goes on in the grid's order too, where it used to follow TikTok's. On the Liked tab the button sits under TikTok's note about who can see your liked videos instead of covering it (#180).
* New switch under `Remove avatar rings`: `Open the Story when a creator is LIVE`. When someone who's LIVE also has a Story, tapping their picture on their profile or on your chat with them in the Inbox opens the Story, and tapping it again joins the LIVE. It starts off (#233).
* With `Record LIVEs you watch` on, a LIVE room's Share sheet has a `LIVE recording quality` row. Tap it to pick the quality the next recording uses without going to Hushfeed settings (#203).
* With `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` on, Share > Video quality also shows in gaming and football LIVE rooms. TikTok left it out of LIVE Studio rooms and rooms that support low latency (#37).
* In dark mode, the newer Video quality picker in a LIVE room's menu is readable again. Its rows sit on a white card, and Original, 1080p and the rest came out light on it, so they were hard to make out. They turn dark on the card now (#57).
* With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, a LIVE room stays dark when your phone switches between light and dark while the room is open. Before, its Share sheet opened white until you left and came back (#159).
* New switch under Share sheet: `Allow Add to Story anyway`. When a creator turned off content reuse, it brings back Add to Story in the share sheet (the button in the row of actions and your story's bubble at the start of Send to) and on their stories, like `Allow Duet and Stitch` does for those two. TikTok may still refuse the post (#88).
* With Region spoof's `Match locale and timezone` on, chat date headers follow the preset's time zone now instead of the phone's clock (#184, #198).

* `Keep photos as TikTok sent them` now also covers stickers that don't move, and `Download original photos` keeps TikTok's own file when it's on (#229).

## What's changed

* Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.5.3 and drops 47.4.3. Grab the 47.5.3 APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, and your login and settings carry over. PineDrama stays on 47.4.3.
* `Remove unused language packs` now patches PineDrama 47.4.3 too. Its language files list the same 25 languages as TikTok's but word the list differently, and the patch stopped at that instead of trimming them.
* `Search loaded activity` puts its search bar back on the Inbox's Activity page. Since 0.77.0 the bar never showed up, because Hushfeed was still looking for TikTok's list under the names an older TikTok gave it.
* New `Double tap by corner` switch under `Double tap` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. Turn it on and each quarter of the video gets its own double tap choice, so the top left can open the comments while the bottom right keeps TikTok's like. Off, `Double tap` works like before. The idea and first version came from @OmerKurdi79 (#232).
* Settings search remembers what you looked for. With the box empty it lists your last ten searches, newest first. Tap one to run it again, tap the bin to forget it, or clear the list at the bottom. A search is kept once you press search on the keyboard, open one of its results or flip a switch it found, and the list stays out of backups (#232).
* New `Keep Clear display across videos` switch in the Clear display part of Hushfeed settings > Feed screen. It's on by default, which is how Clear display has carried over until now. Turn it off and a Clear display you turn on by hand lasts for that video only, so the next one starts with its buttons showing (#232).
* Patching is faster. Many patches used to search every class in TikTok for the code they change, and now they look it up by a string, a number or a name the patcher already keeps an index of. With every patch on 47.4.3, a desktop run went from 89 to 60 seconds and the patching step itself from 54 to 26. The APK that comes out is the same.
* `Sort loaded videos on profile grids` sorts the videos a profile or Liked grid has loaded. You can put the newest or oldest first, the longest or shortest, or the most viewed or most liked. Pinned videos stay first, videos with no value for that order go last, and new pages are sorted in as you scroll. `Original order` is TikTok's own. It only changes videos the grid has already loaded, not the ones it hasn't fetched yet (#180).
* `Fit the video to the screen` now shows photo slideshows whole on a squarer screen too. Each slide sits centered with black above and below instead of losing the top and bottom, and swiping, the dots, the caption and the music line work as before. On a normal tall phone nothing changes (#188).
* New `Keep captions available` switch under Hushfeed settings > Feed screen > Captions. TikTok hides the Captions switch in its accessibility settings, and the caption controls that go with it, for some accounts and regions. Turn this on and they come back. Captions still only show on videos that carry them. It's off by default and takes a TikTok restart to apply (#217).
* `Match locale and timezone to country` now makes that country's time zone TikTok's own from the moment it starts, daylight saving included. Before, only the zone TikTok reports changed. Hushfeed's own clocks (the daily limit's reset, the sleep timer and Auto streak's send time) stay on your phone's time (#184, #198).
* New `Seek bar on sound previews` switch under Hushfeed settings > Playback, part of `Show the progress bar`. When you play a sound's preview on its page, a line along the bottom of the cover shows how far in you are and how long the preview runs. Tap or drag it to jump around in the preview. The line goes away when the preview stops, and a sound that can't be skipped through keeps TikTok's own controls. It's off by default (#185).
* `Keep faded controls in Clear display` keeps the like, comment, save and share buttons on screen again. Newer TikTok builds hide the whole button column at once in Clear display instead of each button, so the buttons stayed away even with the switch on (#209).
* The diagnostic report no longer calls the video controls broken for accounts without the Following stories button. TikTok only shows that button to some accounts, and every Clear display without it got counted as a missing part (#209).
* The diagnostic report can now say which LIVE room a comment went to. Turn on `Log diagnostics`, and each LIVE comment line carries a short code for its room and for the room you entered last, so two comments can be compared without showing any room id (#110).
* Hushfeed now needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Update Manager before you patch. It's built on Morphe's 2.0 patcher, which only unpacks the parts of TikTok a patch asks for, so patching takes less time and memory. With every patch on, a desktop run took about half as long. * `Comments beside the video` now really opens the comments next to the video on a wide window, in PineDrama as well. TikTok's server tells phones they aren't tablets, and the feed then skipped the side panel even with the switch on, so comments still slid up over the video (#26).
* With `Caption background` on Dark or Black, the strip's corners are TikTok's small rounded ones again. The last fix copied TikTok's shape, and on some phones that copy came out much rounder than TikTok's own captions (#158).
* With Accent color's Follow the wallpaper option, the follow plus under a creator's avatar takes the wallpaper color too. It's a picture with the red drawn in, so it used to stay red. Now the patch splits it into a white plus and a circle the phone colors (#163).
* `Hide the comment bar on opened videos` also hides the Message bar that shows up in that spot on a mutual friend's video. It used to stay behind and sit over the caption (#153).
* When the music disc is the last button on the right side, it no longer sits on top of the progress bar and the time after the comment bar is hidden. The buttons now move up far enough to clear the disc too (#153).
* `Hide search suggestions` also stops the trending search that rotates in the grey text inside the search box. The box keeps its plain "Search" placeholder, and tapping search on an empty box doesn't run TikTok's pick anymore. PineDrama's search box gets the same treatment.
* `Hide the Tako bubble` also takes the "People also ask Tako" block out of search results. That's the list of questions with the Tako icon that sits between the videos, where each question opens Tako. The videos close up where it was.
* `Remove feed ads` also hides the hotel deals block in search results, the one with a cashback banner over hotels priced by booking sites. A landmark's place card and the Must Eat lists stay, and so do videos tagged with a hotel.
* With `Show the time to the second` on, a story's header shows when it was posted to the minute, like "3:04 PM", with the day in front when the story is from yesterday. Stories used to get the feed's long text with seconds and the time zone, which crowded the creator's name off the line.
* `Hide CAPTCHA popups` works in the first seconds after TikTok opens. TikTok checks in with its account servers by itself at every start, and the switch took that for you changing your sign-in, so a puzzle in those first seconds always showed. Real sign-in changes still let their puzzle through. With `Log diagnostics` on, the log also names the address of the first action that let a puzzle through (#111, #87).
* New `New device identity` row on the Privacy page, under `Hide root`, and PineDrama has it too. Tap it and restart, and the app wipes its data and comes back with a new Android ID and advertising ID, so TikTok's servers hand it a new device ID instead of the old one. Clearing the app's data in Android isn't enough for that, since the servers give the old device ID back when they see the same two IDs again. You'll be signed out, and your drafts and the offline videos saved inside TikTok go with the rest of its data. Hushfeed's settings, save records and seen history stay, and tapping the row again before the restart cancels it.
* Stopping a backup or an export while the file app had it no longer counts as a Hushfeed error, in PineDrama either. With the error toast debug option on, a toast used to pop up over the row's own answer once the file app finally let go, and the diagnostics log filed the stop under errors.
* Feature Gate Lab's Import loaded values takes a real export again. Since September it turned down every one, the Lab's own included, as "isn't a loaded-values export, or it's larger than the Lab accepts", because a full export holds about 15,000 values and the import stopped at 1,024. A file that's been unpacked from its .gz imports too. When the values that differ would take the Lab past its 1,024 overrides, it now says how many there would have been and changes nothing.
* When Feature Gate Lab turns something down and says why, like a change past its 1,024 overrides or a loaded-values file from another TikTok version, that's no longer logged as a Hushfeed error. With the error toast debug option on, a toast used to cover the Lab's own answer. A file the Lab can't read at all still counts as an error.
* `Remove unused language packs` no longer stops the whole patch run when its list names a language TikTok doesn't have, like `sr` (TikTok has no Serbian pack). That code is skipped and the patch log says so. A code that isn't a language at all still stops it, and the message now lists the codes this TikTok carries (#196).
* `Report a problem` leaves the bug form's What went wrong box empty, with What happened and What I expected shown as a hint. When the link filled them in, the box came back untouched on every report, and two people said it wouldn't take their text (#197, #201).
* Photo posts Hushfeed saves itself now count for `Check for already-saved videos` and get the ✓ from `Mark saved videos`. That covers photos saved with `Download original photos` on, posts saved with `Save photo posts as a video` on and anything picked on a profile grid. Saving one again offers Open or Save again, like a video does. Before, only videos were remembered (#197).
* Photo posts picked on a profile grid are saved as one video when `Save photo posts as a video` is on, the same as Download does on a single post. The picker used to save their photos every time (#197).
* Hiding Like in `Hide buttons in the right column` closes the column up like the other buttons do. Its row stayed behind as an empty space between the avatar and the comments (#190).
* New `Hide reply previews` switch on the Comments page. TikTok opens one reply under some comments before you tap View replies, often the creator's. With the switch on, those comments show just View replies, and tapping it still loads every reply, that one included (#193).
* `SIM country preset` now lists Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Slovenia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania and Bulgaria too. Each one fills in a real carrier from that country, and with `Match locale and timezone to country` on, TikTok gets that country's time zone (#198).
* The native alignment checker now catches RELRO ranges that would make writable data read-only on 16 KB devices. Safely isolated RELRO segments remain accepted.
* The patch audit now checks saved results against their definitions, tested APK and build receipt, including the actual evidence files. Older or incomplete runs stay marked historical. Screenshot verdicts can't be applied to a different run.
* Device builds and audits now require an exclusive lease before accessing a test device. An expired or lost lease stops device commands. Local builds still work without one. The probe tools (strip-hunt, record-markers and every probe action) and the injected-register check take the same lease now, and they won't start while another task holds the phone.
* With `Log diagnostics` on, each card in the search results also logs its type codes (origin and token type, whether it's shopping, its popup type) and the names of the keys in its data. Of what those keys hold, only one-word type codes get logged, so the search and the card's text stay out of the log. That's what it takes to tell a hotel price card or a leaked search ad apart from a normal place card.

## What's changed

* A profile background saved with the Profile background switch on no longer disappears after TikTok restarts. TikTok asks its servers for profiles with a value that left the background out, and the switch now sends the one that brings it back, the same one Feature Gate Lab's Profile banner preset sets. Flipping the switch now offers a restart (#80).
* Feed filter has a Minimum video length beside the maximum, under Limits. Videos shorter than it are hidden, while photo posts and videos TikTok sent no length for stay. Like the maximum, when a whole batch would go, the video closest to your limit is kept (#154).
* Saving a story on Automatic quality now gets its tallest version that other players can open, not the smaller one TikTok's player happened to be streaming. A story whose own clean file is already that tall keeps it, and one with nothing better saves the way it did before (#155).
* Turning a commenter switch on or off under Hushfeed settings > Comments now changes the comments of a video you'd already opened. Before, reopening those comments showed the names and countries they were first drawn with until you moved to another video or restarted TikTok. A verified badge after a name stays where it is.
* A new Color commenter names switch under Hushfeed settings > Comments gives each commenter's name a color of its own. An account gets the same one every time it shows up, a darker shade on TikTok's light comment panel and a lighter one on its dark panel, so a long thread is easier to follow. It starts off.

A video you watch on the tab stays put while more load under it, and one you saw earlier is taken out when it turns up.
* A video you're watching on For You or Following stays put when TikTok reads the list again. It used to vanish from under you once it got older than your Maximum post age, once Hide videos you have already seen counted it as watched, or when its counts moved past a range or views per like limit you set. Videos that come in after it still go through every rule. Turning a rule on or changing one checks them all again, though Hide videos you have already seen still leaves alone the ones you watched in that list.

Show the time zone (on, so the row reads as before) can drop the zone, and Short date writes the date the short way your language does, like 10/7/25. Each works without the other, the seconds always stay, and both use your language's own formats and your phone's 12 or 24 hour clock (#147).

Its videos get the same circle, in the top left corner there since TikTok's own Select posts box takes the top right. Pick all reads the folder's list, so a whole collection saves in runs of 50 like a Liked or Favorites list (#27).

It tries again only the photos that failed, in the post's order and under the same file names, so the ones that landed aren't saved a second time. Photos you cancelled or didn't pick are left out, and Retry keeps showing up as long as some still fail. A Retry made under another account than the one you're on now says so instead of saving. Tap Retry while that post is still saving and it says so, and it stays there to tap again once the save is done.

Nothing from before the tap is saved. If the LIVE ends, the connection drops or the phone runs low on room, you get what was recorded so far and a message that says so (#37).

* The diagnostic report no longer says the overlay is missing something just because Hide the comment bar on opened videos is on while you're on the main feed, which never has that bar (#153).
* The diagnostic report's storage section no longer shows part of your account ID as a folder name. TikTok names its offline videos folder after the account (#70).
* With Hide the comment bar on opened videos on, photo posts in an opened grid no longer end above a black band at the bottom.
