## Summary
PixelBoard v1.2.0 introduces Features Menu accessibility and TalkBack focus fixes, fused APK native split readiness verification for voice typing, automated clipboard screenshot observer synchronization, Sign-to-Text (ASL translation) camera integration, smart auto-correction with primary-key revert, and refined typing suggestions on top of Google's latest **Gboard v18.4.1 Release** (`18.4.1.985164140-release-arm64-v8a`).

---

## What's New in This Release (v18.4.1-V7 / Patch v1.2.0)

### 1. Features Menu Accessibility & TalkBack Navigation ([#48](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/48))
- **Screen Reader Announcements**: Resolved an issue where opening the features menu / "More options" (`AccessPointsPanel`, `AccessPointsPanelV2`, `AccessPointsPanelViewPage`) failed to notify TalkBack and accessibility services of window state changes.
- **Automated Focus Traversal**: Sets accessibility pane title (`resolvePaneTitle`), dispatches `AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED`, and automatically shifts focus to the first accessible tool or keycap (`SoftKeyView` / button).

### 2. Dictation JNI Readiness for Fused APKs & Offline Voice Typing ([#50](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/50))
- **Fused Base APK Compatibility**: Direct JNI library loading verification (`NativeLibHelper.c("dictation_jni", false)`) prevents dictation readiness checks from failing on fused APKs that lack Play feature-split markers.
- **Fused Target Hooks**: Added seamless bytecode patching for fused readiness target `slc` (`Lqeq;->e(Lqem;)Z`).
- **Offline Language Pack Download Interception**: Resolved offline voice typing download failures (such as traditional Chinese `zh-TW`) by handling offline recognition pack URL resolution cleanly.

### 3. Clipboard & Screenshot Observer Synchronization ([#52](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/52))
- **Foreground Screenshot Observer**: Added `ensureScreenshotObserver(handler)` calling `ClipboardDataHandler.q(true)` on `onStartInputView`, ensuring screenshot chips and clipboard items update immediately on display.
- **XML Default Overrides**: Enforced `defaultValue = "true"` directly in `res/xml/setting_clipboard.xml` for `enable_screenshot_in_clipboard` and `pref_key_enable_clipboard`.
- **Emoji Suggestions**: Unconditionally enables `pref_key_enable_emoji_suggestion` as default `true`.

### 4. Sign-to-Text (Signboard ASL Real-Time Translation)
- **American Sign Language Camera Translation**: Enabled native camera gesture translation to convert American Sign Language into text on supported devices.
- **Phenotype Flag Enforcement**: Activated `enable_signboard`, `signboard_prompt_manual_trigger`, `on_demand_feature_split`, `auto_show_signboard`, `signboard_auto_show_prompt`, `signboard_download`, `signboard_download_dialog`, `signboard_move_ap_prompt`, and `use_4c_in_signboard`.

### 5. Smart Auto-Correction & Typing Refinements ([#52](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/52))
- **Primary-Key Revert**: Enforced `auto_correct_with_replace_text = true` and `enable_revert_auto_correct_on_pk = true` (enables reverting auto-corrections via backspace/tap on physical and soft keyboards).
- **Out-of-the-Box Auto-Correction**: Pre-seeds `pref_key_auto_correction = true` by default.
- **Typo Protection**: Tuned `intended_oov_min_count` from `1L` to `2L` so mistyped words typed once (e.g. "olle") are not mistakenly learned into user vocabulary, allowing spacebar auto-correction to properly commit corrections.

### 6. Version 1.2.0 Synchronization
- **System-Wide Alignment**: Synchronized patch bundle version `1.2.0` across Gradle build properties, settings UI, preferences metadata, and bundle manifests.

## What's New in This Release (v18.4.1-V5 / Patch v1.0.9)

### 1. AI Writing Tools / Quick Insert Crash Fix (Android 16 Compatibility)
- **Null Safety Safeguard**: Resolved an app crash when using Quick Insert or expanding AI writing tool suggestions under Android 16.
- **Resilient Spans**: Safeguarded `GboardAiWritingToolsRuntime.java` against empty context spans and missing contextual text services, falling back cleanly to standard input.

### 2. Modern Spell Checker Suggestion Chips & Grammar Checking (`GboardSpellCheckerChipsPatch`)
- **Android 12+ Inline Suggestion Chips**: Bytecode-level transformation hooking Gboard's spell checker utility class (`rcq.m` and `rcq.o`), forcing modern inline spellcheck suggestion chips and add-to-dictionary UI on all Android 12+ devices.

PixelBoard v1.0.7 brings key typing engine improvements, quality-of-life enhancements, and customization features directly to Google's latest **Gboard v18.4.1 Release** (`18.4.1.985164140-release-arm64-v8a`). This update introduces **Instant Word Learning & 2-Letter Prefix Suggestions**, **Contextual Emoji Suggestions**, **Stable Autocorrect & Fluid Glide Typing**, **PixelBoard Spell Checker & Settings Branding**, **Inline Autofill / Password Manager Support**, **Restored Emoji Size Slider**, **Vibrant Candidate Strip Emojis**, **Samsung & Vivo Clipboard History Sync**, **Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys**, and a streamlined Advanced Settings experience with zero required restarts.

## What's New & Fixed in This Release

### 1. Improved Autocorrect, Fast Word Learning, Emoji Suggestions & Glide Typing ([#33](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/33))
- **Instant Word Learning & 2-Letter Prefix Suggestions**: Lowered `intended_oov_min_count` threshold from 4 to 1 and activated Delight5 language model user history n-gram frequency, continuation scoring, and timestamp tracking (`enable_pc_user_history_ngram_count`, `populate_ngram_count_with_context`, `enable_dynamic_lm_unigram_continuation_scoring`, `enable_multiword_predictions_from_user_history`). Frequently typed words are learned immediately and suggested after typing just the first two letters.
- **Contextual Emoji Suggestions**: Activated Delight5 concept prediction engine and emoji shortcut candidates (`enable_concept_prediction_engine`, `enable_rule_based_concept_prediction`, `enable_emoji_suggestion_from_top_candidate`, `enable_predictions_from_emoji_shortcuts`, `config_expression`). In addition, `res/xml/setting_expression.xml` now defaults `pref_key_enable_emoji_suggestion` to `true`, displaying matching emojis directly in the suggestion strip when typing associated words.
- **Stable Autocorrect & Consistent Glide Typing**: Enabled streaming touch gesture tagging (`update_streaming_touch_data_set_is_gesture`) so continuous glide paths are accurately recognized as gestures without stroke stutter. Activated the Delight5 two-stage beam decoder (`enable_two_stage_decoder`), spatial model features, and auto-correction trigger predictors (`enable_space_transposition_post_correction`, `enable_pk_spatial_model_features`, `enable_pk_auto_correction_trigger_predictor`), providing accurate, consistent word completions and auto-corrections.

### 2. PixelBoard Spell Checker & Settings Rebranding
- **PixelBoard Spell Checker**: Rebranded the text services spell checker component to **PixelBoard Spell Checker** with full multi-locale support across all 100+ language resource directories.
- **Valid Resource ID Resolution**: Preserved compiled XML resource references (`@string/string_0x7f140d61`) in `res/xml/spell_checker.xml` to ensure Android's OS `SpellCheckerInfo` framework correctly retrieves the display label in the system "Choose spellchecker" selector.
- **PixelBoard Settings Branding**: Updated main settings header, activity label, and preferences screens (`res/xml/settings.xml`, `res/xml/settings_legacy.xml`) from *Gboard settings* to **PixelBoard Settings**.

### 3. Inline Autofill & Password Manager Support ([#24](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/pull/24))
- **Fix Password Manager Chips**: Resolved an issue where password manager suggestions (Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass, Proton Pass, etc.) failed to show inline above the keyboard on the renamed package.
- **DeviceIntelligence Module Activation**: The renamed package does not receive server-side Phenotype configuration, leaving Android's `DeviceIntelligence` module disabled. Overriding `enable_device_intelligence=true` at runtime allows `onCreateInlineSuggestionsRequest` to load and render inline autofill credentials seamlessly (credits: @alincornel).

### 4. Restored Emoji Size Slider Preference ([#26](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/26))
- **Unlocked Native Slider**: Overrides the `emoji_scale_supported` Phenotype flag to restore the missing interactive **Emoji size** slider and live row preview under **PixelBoard Settings > Emojis, stickers & GIFs**.
- **Adjustable Key Scale**: Freely adjust the size and number of emojis displayed in a row directly within native Gboard preferences.

### 5. Vibrant Suggestion Strip Emojis ([#26](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/26))
- **100% Paint Vibrancy**: Fixed faded, washed-out emojis appearing in the candidate suggestion strip while typing.
- **Candidate View Hook**: Hooked `AutoCenterScaleTextView.onDraw` to ensure candidate text paint renders with full 100% opacity (`alpha = 255`) when emojis are present, eliminating secondary candidate dimming and matching the vibrant look of the emoji drawer.

### 6. Clipboard History Sync for Samsung One UI & Vivo Devices ([#17](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/17))
- **Empty Clipboard Fix**: Fixed the issue where copied text appeared in the immediate suggestion chip but failed to save into the clipboard drawer history on Samsung One UI and Vivo (OriginOS / FuntouchOS) devices.
- **Foreground Clip Sync**: Hooked `onStartInputView` to guarantee `ClipboardManager` listener initialization and sync copied text into clipboard drawer history when typing, overcoming OEM background clipboard suppression on Samsung and Vivo devices.

### 7. Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys (Belka UI) ([#14](https://github.com/Akshayykadam/PixelBoard/issues/14))
- **Pill-Shaped Keycaps**: Added a toggle under **★ Advanced settings** to activate Google's expressive Material 3 Belka rounded keyboard styling.
- **Dynamic Flag Management**: Automatically forces `belka_rounded_keyboard`, `belka_ui`, `belka_background`, `more_pill_keys`, and `enable_rounded_keys` flags at runtime without restarting.

### 8. Clean Advanced Settings & Hot-Reload
- **Streamlined Preferences Screen**: Cleaned up Advanced Settings to focus on rock-solid core toggles (**Enable AI Writing Tools**, **Support All Keyboards**, **Inference Backend Type**, **Enable Advanced Voice Typing**, and **Rounded Keys**); the experimental V2 toggle has been hidden.
- **Zero-Restart Architecture**: All changes take effect immediately on the fly without restarting Gboard, force-closing the app, or rebooting your device.

# PixelBoard v18.0.3 (Stable Release)

**PixelBoard** brings Google Pixel's flagship **Gemini Rambler Voice Typing** and in-line **AI Writing Assistant** to any modern Android device and designed to run safely side-by-side with your existing Gboard.

---

### Highlights & Features

#### 1. Gemini "Rambler" Natural Voice Dictation
Unlocks Google’s next-gen speech engine:
- **Automatic Speech Cleanup**: Strips out hesitations, stuttering, and filler words (*"um"*, *"uh"*, *"like"*, *"you know"*) in real time.
- **Thought Correction**: Intelligently updates sentences when you change your mind mid-thought (e.g. *"meet me at two no, three"* ➔ *"Meet me at 3:00"*).
- **Contextual Punctuation & Capitalization**: Automatically structures sentences, commas, and proper nouns without voice commands.

#### 2. In-Line AI Writing Assistant
Access Google's Gemini-driven writing suite directly above your keyboard:
- **One-Tap Proofread**: Instant grammar and spelling corrections.
- **Tone & Style Switcher**: Rephrase sentences into *Professional*, *Casual*, *Concise*, or *Emotive* tones.
- **Universal Keyboard Support**: Extended to work across all input layouts and languages.

#### 3. Zero-Risk Coexistence (No Root Required)
- **Side-by-Side Installation**: Uses custom package ID `com.akshaykadam.pixelboard` — installs alongside your stock Google Keyboard without overwriting it.
- **Signature Bypass**: Pre-patched to bypass Google Play signature checks and integrity verifications seamlessly.
- **Dedicated Advanced Settings**: Includes a custom Material preference screen with a one-tap process restart (`↻`) toolbar button to quickly reload Gboard services.

   - Open PixelBoard Settings > **Voice typing**.
   - Under **Dictation type**, change from *Standard* to **Rambler**.
4. **Apply Changes**:
   - Return to PixelBoard Settings, scroll down and tap **★ Advanced settings**.

5. **Start Typing**: Tap any text field, hit the **Microphone** icon, tap **Get started**, and speak naturally!

## [0.1.0](https://github.com/pigfoot/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v0.1.0) (2026-10-06)

### Changed

- Package renaming is optional and unselected by default. Without it RailsGo retains its original package, provider authorities, permissions and link scheme.
- Selecting Change package name uses the default .morphe or a custom package and applies complete parallel isolation without changing the app display name.
- Sideload startup compatibility is required for supported standard and Shizuku installs; the bus patch depends on it, not package renaming. Root mount remains unqualified and unavailable.
- Preserve the helper-only extension, loaded reward metadata, original fallback and callback deduplication.
- Publish readable dependency names and clean preflight bundle outputs before future versioned releases.

### Migration

Existing .morphe or custom-package installs must select Change package name, keep the same package value and use the same local signing key to update. This release replaces the earlier 1.0.0 numbering; patch behavior is unchanged. Device startup and live bus updates still require phone validation.

## Pigfoot Patches v0.0.1

Initial release of the rebuilt repository using the official Morphe Gradle layout.

- RailsGo 1.25.2 (156), arm64-v8a APKS only.
- Change package name: configurable package with provider, permission and link isolation. The original app display name is preserved.
- Sideload startup compatibility remains a required dependency.
- Scoped bus-update completion retains loaded reward metadata, fallback behavior and duplicate-callback protection.
- Java extension with compile-only declarations excluded from the shipped bundle.
- English documentation and semantic-release automation for subsequent releases.

Keep the default package name and the same local signing key to update an existing patched installation. Device startup and live bus updates require phone validation after the Java extension migration.

- chess.com's game review asks who reviews each game: chess.com, lichess with your lichess account, or stockfish 19 on your phone, offline and with no daily limit. the phone and lichess mark moves the lichess way, right in chess.com's review screen. the local and lichess reviews are still in beta
- stockfish also shows its best moves on finished games, the analysis boards and the game explorer, with an eval bar where chess.com has none. the stockfish analysis patch downloads the official stockfish 19 (80 mb) while morphe manager patches, so patching chess.com with it needs internet
- lichess puzzles play offline in chess.com's own puzzle screen and get rated on your phone the way lichess rates them
- the first time you open the patched app, a short setup screen lets you set up game review and download a puzzle pack
- every bot can be played, play coach has no daily limit, and content the app itself keeps for premium opens up

- review on lichess is gone, game review's lichess option replaces it

- new app: geocaching 10.21.0, with every feature as its own switch. map filters, statistics from your finds, log templates, lists, experimental features and finds and hides sorting work without premium, and the upgrade badges are gone
- caches the app locks behind premium open too, with what geocaching.com shows your account. map search comes from geocaching.com as well, and the caches you see on the map or open stay on the phone for offline use
- the geocaching map needs no google key, has free street, satellite, terrain and hybrid layers, and comes back faster when you switch tabs
- geocaching also gets a native description viewer, photo downloads and one sign-in for the app and the website
- gboard's app icon works again and walks you through setup: it opens the keyboard list to turn it on, then the picker to choose it, and gboard's settings once it's all set

First release. My Morphe patches for the apps I use, in one source. These are the apps it starts with:

- chess.com 4.10.18: arrows and marked squares in every game, your own board and accent colours, amoled black, the website's arcade animations, a home screen and bottom bar you choose, time controls under a minute and game review on lichess, with no ads, rating prompts or premium upsells
- block blast 10.8.1: classic trays dealt by the ios game's own code, its colour, block, menu and animation themes and its extra effects, no ads, no revive offer, no impossible trays, a quicker game over and an optional fake best score
- gboard 18.2.4: no internet permission and no google services, voice typing and translation that run on the phone, gifs from sources you pick through a small helper app, and the keyboard no longer mirrors for right-to-left languages, plus a few features ported from jasonwu1994's gboard patches

**Installing**: add this repo as a source in Morphe Manager with the link in the README, then patch the apps from there.

## [0.22.5](https://github.com/Forsigh/waze-patches/compare/v0.22.4...v0.22.5) (2026-10-13)

### 🗑️ Removed

* **AMOLED dark mode** is removed. On-device testing once more showed the app failing at startup
  with the row ticked - a loading screen, then an error, then exit - so the skin-value rewrite is

## [0.22.4](https://github.com/Forsigh/waze-patches/compare/v0.22.2...v0.22.4) (2026-10-13)

### 🗑️ Removed

* **Map theme** and **OLED dark mode** are removed. Both rewrote Waze's map skin inside the APK; on-device
  testing showed the app breaking with them - the OLED black swallowed the map contents and the theme
  selector broke the map - so the full skin-rewrite approach is retired with them. The skin files ship
  stock again, and the versionCode refresh now waits for the mood artwork *and* the AMOLED row below -
  a minimal, night-only rebuild of the same idea, informed by the first attempt's post-mortem

### ✨ New patch

* **Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner** replaces "Add your own media apps as Waze audio
  partners": a direct port of Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch (GPLv3, release v1.0.2, credited in the
  README and the source). The package is declared in Waze's manifest `<queries>` - without it Android's
  package visibility hides it from Waze entirely - and inserted into `SdkConfiguration.appConfigs` when
  `updateAppList` rebuilds the roster: upstream's `containsKey`-guarded block right after the scope save,
  built with the five-argument `au` constructor and feature bits `0x200001`
* the custom machinery is retired rather than kept alongside: the `partners` / `alsoAllowPackage` /
  `mediaBrowserAction` / `allowAllPackages` options, the `au.g` availability override and the audio-SDK
  config forcing are all gone. On-device testing under the previous build did not produce a working
  partner, and upstream's exact pair is what its own users run
* the row is on by default, exactly as upstream lists it
* **AMOLED dark mode** (opt-in, off by default) - the second, informed attempt at the AMOLED night map:
  night skin files only, the canvas becomes true black (`#000000`) and the nine road families are lifted
  15% toward white (the first attempt used 10%) so they keep their contrast against it. Day mode, labels,
  traffic and route colours stay stock, and the day files are asserted byte-identical. Two measured facts
  from the first attempt's post-mortem shape it: `map_background` is also the render tree's "eraser"
  colour (referenced ~20 times as feature strokes), so the black cascades by design to match the canvas,
  and the higher lift compensates the dark-on-dark night palette. Applied at patch time; nothing injected
* **Disable Play Store updates** (opt-in, off by default) - a port of Morphe's universal patch of the same
  name (`MorpheApp/morphe-patches`, GPLv3, credited): the manifest version code is locked above Play's
  2,100,000,000 ceiling, so the store always sees the installed copy as newer and never offers or applies
  an update. Two deliberate Waze adaptations: the locked value is `2,100,000,000 + minutes since 2026`
  rather than a frozen maximum, because Waze re-extracts its skins only when the versionCode *changes* -
  frozen, it would silently freeze every future skin edit; and instead of upstream's rewrite-everything
  preserve, only Waze's own package-version accessor (`com.waze.utils.n.a`, the push module's source) is
  made to report the pre-lock code, while the two extraction gates keep seeing the change. The manifest
  write runs in the resource half's `finalize`, so the lock is the last word on the number regardless of
  selection order
* the descriptions Morphe and the README show for every patch got a plain-language pass, and the credits
  section now lists only sources whose work actually ships in the bundle

## [0.22.2](https://github.com/Forsigh/waze-patches/compare/v0.22.1...v0.22.2) (2026-10-11)

## 追加・改善

- 既読なしで開いた通常トークに、メッセージごとの「既読にする」と、現在のトークの「すべて既読にする」を追加しました。メニュー・通知からの既読なし入室に共通で作用します。
- 個別操作は未読メッセージの時刻の下の小さな文字リンクにしました。既読済みメッセージには表示せず、既読・未読の境界だけに「ここまで既読」の水平線を表示します。
- 「すべて既読にする」は入力欄の上にフローティング表示します。最新メッセージの個別操作が隠れないよう、一覧の下端に余白を確保します。
- 既読無効の案内をトーク名のヘッダー直下へ移し、ヘッダーが押し下がる問題を修正しました。
- 手動操作後も、その後のメッセージの自動既読は抑制したままです。既存の設定値は引き継ぎます。

## 個別操作について

LINEの既読は位置で管理されるため、「既読にする」は選んだメッセージ以前を含む累積既読です。後のメッセージだけを既読にして、それ以前を未読に戻す操作ではありません。

個別操作ではトーク全体の未読件数を解除しません。全体を解除するには「すべて既読にする」を使ってください。

| [Disable voice ads](#disable-voice-ads) | Mutes the sponsored voice ads so they don't interrupt your drive. You still get navigation directions and road warnings, with the same audio controls. |  |
| [Hide banner ads](#hide-banner-ads) | Gets rid of banner ads on the map, during navigation and on the dashboard, including ad placeholders. Keeps road alerts and route controls in place. |  |
| [Override local PRO checks](#override-local-pro-checks) | Keeps local PRO mode on and opens up the PRO settings. Hides the Switch to PRO toggle. Purchases and server-side perks aren't changed. |  |
| [Suppress Premium promotions](#suppress-premium-promotions) | Hides PRO promo cards and upgrade shortcuts, including the sidebar card, and closes the PRO page. Donation and voucher pages stay available. |  |

HushTumblr 0.0.9 has 46 patches for Tumblr 46.8.1.100. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer.

Two patches are new: Hide suggested tags and Hide filtered posts. Both live on the Feed page in HushTumblr settings and stay off until you turn them on. Hide ads now reaches blog pages, your likes and blog search. Hide suggested blogs catches the follow prompt between a blog's posts, and the buttons under a post finally match Dark background color.

Coming from 0.0.8, update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer first. Then patch Tumblr 46.8.1.100 with the default selection and install it over your current build, and your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- The patches move from 46.5.0.109 to Tumblr 46.8.1.100, the newest release. Every patch applies to it, so that's the version to patch.
- The bundle is built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0 now. You'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer, since older Manager builds can't load it.
- With Dark background color on, the row of buttons under each post now matches the post. In Tumblr's Dark palette it used to come out a shade lighter.
- Hide ads and the other feed switches now work on a blog's own posts, your likes and blog search. Those pages kept their own unfiltered copy, so sponsored posts kept turning up between a blog's posts.
- Hide suggested blogs now takes out the "Like this? Follow to see more" prompt and the Follow button under it that show up between a blog's posts. Tumblr sends that prompt as a heading and a lone button, so it got past the blog cards check.
- Hide suggested blogs and Hide suggested communities now reach the Posts tab of a search, where Tumblr slips a tag's top blogs and related communities in between the posts. The Blogs and Communities tabs still list everything the search found.
- New **Hide suggested tags** switch on the Feed page, off by default. It takes out the carousels of tags Tumblr wants you to follow, like "Check out these tags" on the dashboard, "Related tags" in a search and "Explore more" on a tag's page, along with their headings. The "Know someone who'd love this tag?" prompt between a tag's posts goes too. Tags you already follow stay put.
- New **Hide filtered posts** switch on the Feed page, off by default. Posts that Tumblr would cover with "This post contains filtered content" (because of your filtered tags or words) drop out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds. Leave it off and they stay covered like before.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Tumblr crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Tumblr from the release bundle and installs it on a phone or emulator. Then it opens the dashboard, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Tumblr crash earns a PASS.
- `scripts/patch-for-device.ps1` can sign with the key Morphe makes, which has no store password and its own key password. Pass `-NoStorePassword` and put the key password in `HUSHTUMBLR_SIDELOAD_KEY_PASSWORD`.

## Reports this release answers

- #1 The row of buttons under a post didn't follow Dark background color.
- #2 A switch to drop filtered posts instead of covering them.
- #3 Sponsored posts showing up on blogs.
- #4 and #5 Suggested blogs between a blog's posts, and suggested blogs and communities slipped into search.
- #6 A switch to hide suggested tags.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushTumblr release key, fingerprint `2143 368A A5CE 6E5D FFEA  79CF BBC1 3768 83CF 3AB4`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#verify-a-download).

## Validation

All 993 extension tests, 145 patch tests and 109 tests against the real Tumblr 46.8.1.100 build passed for this release, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Tumblr 46.8.1.100 build with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 46 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.9.json` records that result, the build's hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched Tumblr 46.8.1.100 for a signed-in Galaxy S22 Ultra on Android 16, and the app got a walk from end to end. It opened the dashboard, Explore, a search, a tag page, a blog, your likes and all ten HushTumblr settings pages, and Tumblr didn't crash once.

HushTumblr 0.0.8 has 44 patches for Tumblr 46.5.0.109. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer.

Two patches are new: Hide blog notification reminders and Hide gift purchase popups. They're in the default selection, and both stay off until you turn them on from the Interface page in HushTumblr settings. Hide note counts now clears the numbers on a post's notes tabs as well, and Quick setups can be tucked away with a long press if you don't use it.

Coming from 0.0.7, patch Tumblr 46.5.0.109 with the default selection and install it over your current build. Your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- New **Hide blog notification reminders** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that asks you to turn on notifications for it. Your subscriptions and notification settings don't change.
- New **Hide gift purchase popups** switch on the Interface page, off by default. It hides the pop-up on a blog that suggests buying the blog a gift. Crab tips still show, and the gift button on a blog still opens the gift screen.
- Hide note counts now takes the numbers off the Comments, Reblogs and Likes tabs on a post's notes too. The tabs still switch, and the numbers come back once the switch is off and the notes are opened again.
- Quick setups can be hidden from the settings home with a long press on its row, and its help line now says so. The **Quick setups on the home page** row on Pause, backup and diagnostics brings it back. The choice stays out of settings backups and Quick setups, and Pause leaves it alone.
- The Words to hide and Allowed words editors now shrink to fit above the keyboard. With large text and the Samsung keyboard open, Save and Cancel used to sit behind the keyboard.
- Manage muted posts and Clear diagnostic data now read the file back after saving and only say it worked once the new copy is really there. If that check fails, Manage muted posts reloads the list so it shows what's actually saved, says it couldn't update, and lets you try again.

## Behind the scenes

- Patch runs check much more of what they build. Every Tumblr method, field and resource a run changes has to match a reviewed contract or allowlist line, and the bundle, merged APK, patched APK and report stay locked so nothing else on the PC can swap them mid-run. The release receipt patches every fixture itself, and `patch-for-device.ps1` checks the signing key and takes `-Option` for patch options.
- Release checks now refuse malformed vulnerability answers, and a low severity label can't hide a score they can't read. A GitHub description that names no version, count or build is left as written. Morphe Manager's description carries the release's full changelog, and the README matches the published patches. Each release now writes the README's checksum example from the signed bundle, so its label, hash and file name can't fall behind.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushTumblr release key, fingerprint `2143 368A A5CE 6E5D FFEA  79CF BBC1 3768 83CF 3AB4`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#verify-a-download).

## Validation

All 982 extension tests, 145 patch tests and 104 tests against the real Tumblr 46.5.0.109 build passed for this release, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Tumblr 46.5.0.109 build with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 44 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.8.json` records that result, the build's hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before the release, all 44 patches were also run on an Android 16 emulator signed in to a test account. A long press on the Tumblr logo opened the settings. Both new switches showed up on the Interface page, started off and turned on and off without needing a restart. With Hide note counts on, a post's notes tabs showed only their icons, and the numbers came back once it was off. Quick setups hid with a long press and came back from the Pause, backup and diagnostics page. Tumblr picks when to show the blog reminder and gift pop-ups, and neither came up for the test account during the check, so those two patches rest on the tests against the real build.

HushTumblr 0.0.7 is the first update since 0.0.1, with 42 patches for Tumblr 46.5.0.109. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Versions 0.0.2 to 0.0.6 were never published, so everything since 0.0.1 is listed below.

Six patches are new: Mute posts locally, Filter activity notifications, Show post timestamps, Visible image descriptions, Show mutual markers and Reveal allowed mature content. They're in the default selection, and each one stays off until you turn it on in HushTumblr settings.

HushTumblr settings got a full redesign. Every page opens straight from the home page, a change that needs a restart puts a Restart row at the top and brings you back to the same page afterwards, and a long press on the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard opens the settings. There are fixes too, for feeds that stopped on "No results" when a filter emptied a page, search tabs the suggestion filters emptied, and the Communities tab coming back after a restart.

Coming from 0.0.1, patch Tumblr 46.5.0.109 with the default selection and install it over your current build. Your settings stay. Coming from stock Tumblr, uninstall it first, then install the patched app and sign in with your email.

## What's new

- With Debug logging on, the log now says how long the settings' restart marker took to save and to read back, and how long Clear diagnostic data and its undo kept the log locked.
- With Tumblr set to a right-to-left language, the settings' page titles, section headings, search field and dialog labels now sit on the same side as the rows. They used to stay at the left.
- The Support HushTumblr row at the bottom of the settings is now just its title. The line under it is gone, and a tap still opens the Ko-fi page.
- The Hide Blaze prompts switch now says that the Blaze item in a post's menu stays. It hides the buttons, banners and after-post nudge, as before.
- The HushTumblr settings shortcut on Tumblr's icon now opens the settings every time. If Tumblr was still open from the last time you used the shortcut, tapping it again only brought Tumblr back up.
- Hide suggested communities no longer empties a category in Communities' Browse page. The communities listed there stay, and the suggestion cards still go from your dashboard and other feeds.
- A page where every post was hidden no longer leaves a feed on "No results". The feed goes on to the next page, and shows the empty screen only after five empty pages in a row or when there's nothing more to load.
- Hide suggested blogs and Hide suggested communities no longer empty a search's Blogs and Communities tabs. The cards still go from the dashboard and other feeds.
- Visible image descriptions now use the same text color as the post, so they're readable in Tumblr's default True Blue palette. They used to come out light gray on the white card.
- The Tumblr's own settings page now lists where Tumblr keeps six of its own controls, such as autoplay, the dashboard order and filtered tags. Each row shows the path to the control in the language Tumblr is using.
- Dark background color now reaches Tumblr's newer settings screens and the redesigned post card, which used to stay gray. Bars, rows and dialogs sit one step lighter than the page.
- Hide the Communities tab now takes the Communities button off the bottom bar on every start. It used to come back after a restart with nothing behind it.
- Manage muted posts now tells you when this account's list couldn't be read and gives you a Retry button, including when the app was too busy at sign-in to read it. Nothing is changed or deleted while it can't be read.
- Manage muted posts now says that this device keeps muted post lists for eight accounts, and that a ninth account's first mute deletes the list that's gone longest without a change.
- Hide reblogs has a new option, Keep reblogs with added content. Turn it on to keep reblogs where the reblogger added something of their own while empty reblogs stay hidden.
- The setup guide's two help buttons now open Tumblr's own articles on resetting a password and on requesting your personal data. The guide also says that request is made on Tumblr's website, not in the app.
- Long-press the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard to open HushTumblr settings. A tap on the logo still does what it always did.
- Quick setups, under the status card, turns on the Quiet or Privacy switches in one tap, or puts every switch back. A toast says how many changed.
- Report a problem sits just above the Ko-fi row. It opens a GitHub bug report with your versions, phone and switches filled in.
- Settings search no longer matches the word "null" on rows that have no description.
- A change that needs a restart puts a Restart row at the top of every settings page. Tap it and Tumblr reopens on the same page. Hide ads now asks for it too.
- Every settings page opens straight from the HushTumblr home page. Links, Notifications, Updates, backup and About moved off their own More settings page and now sit under a More settings heading, so nothing is more than one tap deep. With TalkBack on, Back scrolls to the row you came from when it's off screen, so focus lands there right away.
- Settings pages have larger headers and short descriptions. Each control has its own navy card, with clearer spacing and rectangular switch thumbs. Short windows use a compact header to keep the list within reach.
- The status card puts Pause or Resume below its message. Both actions save on a worker and prevent repeated taps. Choice dialogs share the page styling, and tab-order rows show an upward arrow for their move action.
- Tab-order actions now draw upward arrows. Switch tracks keep their full size, with evenly inset thumbs.
- A local mute that can't refresh the feed or undo itself keeps an Unmute post action. Recovery changes only that post and preserves later edits to the account's muted list.
- Clearing diagnostic data and putting it back use a shared worker operation. Rows show progress, prevent repeated actions and keep failed restores available to retry.
- Word lists, tab order and switches save on a worker. Busy controls keep the saved value visible, block repeated taps and report failures. Replacement settings pages refresh when an edit finishes. Backup actions stay busy while a failed refresh waits to retry.
- Backup previews and import results count word lists and tab order alongside switches. Import and Undo messages now refer to settings, and the setup guide explains which data the backup includes.
- Settings controls now show focus and disabled states consistently. Search and word fields have clearer boundaries, and dialog actions wrap without losing their touch targets at large text sizes.
- Word editors keep a label above the list, explain when changes are saved and show save errors beside the draft. Long explanations and errors scroll with the editor while Save and Cancel stay within reach.
- The muted-post manager keeps Undo in its own window. Failed changes leave the list available to retry, empty lists explain how to mute a post, and switching accounts closes the old list. Undo also respects Android's accessibility timeout.
- A release check that can't save its result now reports the failure instead of showing an earlier success. Closing settings also closes the setup guide and disables its old actions.
- HushTumblr settings and their dialogs now mirror navigation for right-to-left languages, even when Tumblr's own layouts don't support it.
- Moving a tab keeps TalkBack focus on that tab and announces its new position. Reset and refused saves keep focus aligned with the saved order.
- Hide ads also removes paid Blaze posts from blogs you don't follow. It keeps your own posts and posts from blogs you follow.
- Long word lists now scroll inside the editor, keeping Save and Cancel within reach.
- Saving a word list during an import now checks and saves the combined size in one step. Older backups ignore unsupported allowed-word fields instead of rejecting the whole file.
- Failed saves keep the words draft and the earlier tab order. The words editor also keeps its draft and selection when the settings page is recreated. Import and Undo refresh the list summaries and retain any required restart notice.
- Settings backups check the complete file size before replacing an export. Oversized saved lists stay available to edit, and a refused Save keeps the draft. Diagnostic choices close with their settings page.
- Word matching recognizes canonically equivalent text and checks whole words by Unicode code point. Added field choices and allowed words. Those exceptions affect the word filter only. Hide reblogs can optionally keep reblogs with their own tags.
- Added activity filters for likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops. They start off and leave push notification choices alone. Post timestamps and visible image descriptions also start off.
- Added private post muting to the native post menus, including the redesigned menu and your own blog's menu. It removes originals and their reblogs, with Undo and account-specific management. Optional mature-content reveal keeps Tumblr's age and account restrictions.
- Optional mutual markers use a follower cache for your primary blog. Unknown relationships and sideblogs keep their existing headers.
- Refreshed every HushTumblr settings page with navy cards, pale blue controls and larger page titles. Navigation has outlined icon tiles, and switch descriptions have more room.
- Backup and diagnostic actions now have separate cards. The words editor, tab order list and other dialogs use the same colors as the settings pages. Search, recovery and enlarged text follow the new design too.
- Kept the existing settings, defaults and saved choices. Added current settings screenshots to the README.

## Behind the scenes

- Patched APKs are now checked for devices with 16 KB memory pages before they're kept, receipted or signed for a phone, and Tumblr's own native libraries are confirmed untouched.
- An unsigned universal APK now has to match the merge of the signed bundle beside it file for file, so one that leaves an asset out or carries a swapped resource or resource table is refused before patching.
- The settings, pause and restart checks now also run against Android 17 (API 37).
- The patch scripts refuse a bundle whose file names try to reach outside the folder it's unpacked into. They also check every APK in it against Tumblr's signing certificate, package and version before anything is merged, patched, signed or installed. A bundle that would unpack past 1 GB for one APK, or 2 GB in all, is refused before anything is written, and so is an .xapk whose manifest.json would pass 1 MB. A merged universal APK kept beside its bundle now has to carry that bundle's own files throughout, not only its code and native libraries.
- Settings title checks compile against the public Android SDK.
- Split-input tests check AAPT2's complete manifest split name. Gate-isolation fixtures include both suites that shared merge changes require.
- Concurrent device-build tests keep their queue log intact on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
- Expanded compiled-code checks to cover every patch family and its original fallback, including the redesigned post menus and their retained timeline owners. Altered hooks are rejected before a device build.
- Gallery cleanup is checked against the captions it owns, including recycling while the feature is paused. The verifier rejects unowned removals and escaped caption references.
- Updated the checked Gradle wrapper to 9.8.1. Build and release entry points reject an affected, incomplete or mismatched wrapper before it runs.
- Source updates can keep their notes under Unreleased while the published bundle stays on its released version. Release checks still require a dated entry.
- The README is much shorter now and sticks to what you need to install and use HushTumblr. The longer version is still in the repository history.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Tumblr APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushTumblr release key, fingerprint `2143 368A A5CE 6E5D FFEA  79CF BBC1 3768 83CF 3AB4`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTumblr#verify-a-download).

# 1.0.0 (2026-09-07)


### Features

* **soundcloud:** add download hook, home filter, navigation UI, and settings patches ([b4cb397](https://github.com/lootdev78/morphe-patches-sc/commit/b4cb397c54bdba93a67fd65724516a858998ee5d))

Fixes scrolling from the checkbox column, and makes a failed removal say what went wrong.

### Scrolling

Dragging from a checkbox did nothing. The overlay claimed the whole checkbox gutter the moment you pressed, and then held on to every movement, so the list only scrolled if your finger happened to start on the thumbnail or the title.

A press that travels past the system's drag threshold now gives up on being a tap and hands the gesture to the list, which receives the press it never saw so the scroll starts from the right place. Tapping a checkbox still ticks it.

### Failed removals

Removals are sent in chunks, and the server takes a chunk all or nothing. One entry it refused therefore reported every other entry in that chunk as failed as well. A chunk that fails is now retried one entry at a time, so the entries the server was happy with go through and the failure count is the real one. The extra requests happen only for a chunk that had already failed.

The request also knew exactly why a removal had failed and threw it away, showing one flat "Could not remove the selected videos" for everything from an expired credential to a dropped connection. The reason now reaches the message:

- `Could not remove the selected videos: HTTP 401`
- `Removed 3 videos, 2 failed: timed out`

A 401 there means the credentials the app handed over had gone stale, which previously took a logcat to tell apart from the playlist refusing the edit.

### Known issue

Removing a video while the playlist page is open leaves its row on screen with a greyed out checkbox, until YouTube refetches the page. The video really is gone from the playlist; the row is stale and the dead checkbox is the overlay declining to act on a video it can no longer identify. Leave the playlist and come back to see the real contents.

Fixes checkboxes that stayed on screen after you left the playlist.

Tapping a video to play it left the selection checkboxes drawn on top of the player, in the places the playlist rows had been, and rotating into landscape fullscreen did not clear them either. The action bar had the same problem, and the invisible overlay was also swallowing taps meant for whatever was now in front.

The cause was that nothing tied the overlay to the playlist being on screen. Opening a video does not detach the list, it swaps the page out from under it, and the listener driving the redraw belongs to the window rather than to the list, so it kept firing while the player was up and kept drawing at the coordinates the hidden rows still held.

The overlay and the action bar now follow the playlist page on and off screen. They are hidden rather than torn down, so a selection survives watching a video and is still there when you come back. The miniplayer deliberately does not count as leaving the playlist, since the list stays usable underneath it.

No change to the feature itself.

Fixes a bundle that a manager reported as having **0 patches**.

The published `.mpp` contained no `classes.dex`. Manager runs the patcher on Android, which can only load dex, so it refused the bundle outright with `Patch bundle is missing dex entries` and listed the source with no patches in it.

The cause was in the release tooling, not the patch. `generatePatchesList` depends on the plain `build` task, which re-runs `jar` and rewrites the `.mpp` without the dex that `buildAndroid` had just added. The two were being run in that order. The list is now generated first, `buildAndroid` runs last, and the tooling refuses to publish a bundle that has no `classes.dex`.

This is invisible from the desktop: `morphe-desktop` runs on the JVM and loads the class files, so it downloads, lists and applies a dex-less bundle without complaint. v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 were both affected and should not be used.

No change to the feature itself.

Fixes a bundle that showed **0 patches available** in a manager.

Two things were wrong in v1.0.0, either of which alone produces that:

- The compatibility descriptor declared no app signatures. A manager matches an installed app against those before it will offer any patch, so a bundle without them can match nothing. It now lists YouTube's two signing certificates, the same pair the upstream bundle uses.
- `patches-list.json` reported version `0.1.0` while the release was `1.0.0`. The generator reads the version out of the first `.mpp` it finds in the build directory, and an artifact from an earlier build was still there. The release tooling now clears that directory first and refuses to publish when the generated list disagrees with the version being released.

Also in this release: debug logging is off by default, so the bundle no longer logs playlist fetch counts and timings on your device.

Standalone bundle containing only **Playlist bulk remove**.

Earlier releases of this repo were a fork of the whole upstream bundle, so a manager listed all 148 patches, every one of them duplicated against the official source. This release shares no code with that bundle. It has its own `app.joly0` namespace and holds a single patch, so it is meant to be used **alongside** the official bundle rather than instead of it: add both sources and apply both.

### What it does

Draws a checkbox on each row of a playlist you own and removes every selected video in one request, instead of swiping and confirming one at a time.

Rows are matched to videos by title rather than by position, so reordering a playlist while selecting does not move your ticks onto the wrong videos, and the confirmation dialog lists the videos the selection actually resolved to before anything is deleted.

### Upgrading from v1.43.1-joly0.2

Remove and re-add this source in your manager. `1.0.0` sorts below `1.43.1-joly0.2`, so it will not be offered as an update to an existing install.

Restores missing YouTube Auto-translate menus and expands language coverage using YouTube's per-video metadata.

### Changes
- Restore the native Auto-translate option when valid original captions exist but Android returns an empty translation list.
- Support ASR, uploaded/manual and named captions, including multiple current-audio sources.
- Read target languages dynamically; use the dated 156-language fallback only when native metadata is empty. Preserve regional menu targets.
- Preserve signed source URLs and Morphe's caption preference, Off and manual-selection policies. Existing native menus respect Morphe's additional-language setting.

### Installation
Import `universal-captions-2.1.0.mpp` or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages** alongside **Captions**, using a clean YouTube **21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK. Replace older experimental Universal Captions imports; select only one version. Repatch YouTube to apply the update.

### Validation
The runtime is byte-for-byte identical to device-tested experiment.4. The user reported successful translation, Off/on, audio/source changes and video switching on 21.20.405; the app-process capture showed no crash. Automated construction checks cover 193,440 source/target/locale cases. The full 45-test native-combined suite passed again, and the exact stable MPP passed Android patching/DEX/hierarchy/signing verification on both declared APK versions. Native coexistence in both orders was validated with the identical experimental implementation.

Additional user-reported device testing confirmed working operation across YouTube **20.21.37–21.42.241**, including both endpoints and intermediate versions. Automated APK validation covers **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**.

### Known limits
YouTube may withhold a translation for particular videos/accounts. Native automatic regional preference matching may choose generic `pt` for `pt-PT`; manual menu options remain separate. The fallback uses the current-audio default/native order and does not guarantee tracking every manual source choice.

Universal Captions 2.0.0 expands YouTube’s native Auto-translate language menu and sorts it by localized display name.

- Adds all languages supported by the patch to YouTube’s native Auto-translate menu, while retaining native entries.
- Caption preferences, source selection, visibility and Off behavior are managed by Morphe’s **Captions** patch.
- When the native Morphe additional-language feature is present, its setting controls the menu; the standalone addon leaves that behavior to Morphe.
- Older Morphe builds continue to use the independent language-menu extension.

**Upgrading from 1.4:** version 2.0 is a menu-only addon. Enable Morphe’s **Captions** patch for caption preference and visibility features. Use only one Universal Captions version in each patching session.

**Validated APK targets:** YouTube **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**. All 20 regression tests passed, and standalone and combined-native APKs passed SDK verification on both targets. The release implementation was also confirmed working on-device. Other versions remain unverified; translation availability varies by video and account.

**Install:** update this source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-2.0.0.mpp` from the assets below.

**Install:** add this repository as a source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-1.4.0.mpp`. Replace development-source copies with the release source before patching a clean supported APK.

### New: Fix speed drops

Stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services (e.g. GrapheneOS). Waze's location listener is wrapped so that a fix without a speed gets one from the distance travelled, or keeps the last speed briefly; short gaps can be bridged. Real stops are unaffected. Options: hold speed, braking, bridge gaps. See the README.

### Changes

- The extension no longer bundles the Kotlin standard library (2.2 MB smaller, no clash with Waze's own copy).
- `gradle.properties` is now in the repo, so forks build with the right version.

### Patches

- **Fix speed drops** (new)

Universal Captions 3.0.1 is a maintenance update to 3.0.0. The translation menu and source-selection behavior remain unchanged.

### What's Changed

- **Safer caption parser cleanup:** Cleanup is now request-specific. Native exception handlers can no longer close another decoder's styling scope.
- **Code cleanup:** Removed two test-only `augment()` overloads from the Android extension.
- **Improved test coverage:** Added regression tests for nested exception cleanup and the recorded 156-language fallback catalog.
- **Release workflow fixes:** Corrected the Morphe Manager bundle URL. The workflow now reads the version directly from `patches-list.json` and skips versions that have already been published.
- **Documentation:** Updated the architecture and compatibility documentation.

### Installation

Download `universal-captions-3.0.1.mpp` or refresh the custom source in **Morphe Manager**.

Patch a clean YouTube APK using one of the supported versions: **21.20.405** or **21.41.525**.

### Testing & Compatibility

- Universal Captions 3.0 development builds were manually tested on both supported YouTube versions.
- Version 3.0.1 includes automated regression coverage. The updated parser cleanup has not been separately documented in an on-device test.
- YouTube may still withhold translations for certain tracks or languages.

### Release Files

This release includes the **MPP patch bundle**, patch metadata, and a **SHA-256 checksum** for verification. It does not distribute a modified YouTube APK.

This is the rewrite I've been working toward. The old patch could restore Auto-translate and offer extra languages on many videos, but some still showed just 16–18 choices. Those videos often had several original caption tracks, and copying a translation from the wrong one wasn't a safe fix.

I reverse-engineered the original YouTube caption manager and followed how its metadata connects caption sources to the active audio track. In 3.0 the patch uses that native source-index routing, keeps YouTube's original translated tracks, and adds missing language choices from the correct source. It no longer depends on guessing which caption happens to be the default.

The translated subtitle styling fix has also been rewritten. Instead of using a global flag for the last network request, it identifies the caption during parsing, including cached captions. Original creator styling stays on original subtitles, while affected translations use visible default text styles.

### What's included

- A wider Auto-translate menu, typically around 155–156 languages when an eligible source exists.
- Restored Auto-translate menus for videos with original captions but no translated choices.
- Support for auto-generated, uploaded and named captions, including videos with multiple audio/caption sources.
- Native signed caption URLs and existing per-language selections preserved.
- Caption styling handling scoped to the actual XML parser rather than a process-wide request flag.
- More tests for source identity, signed URLs, multi-audio routing, regional language aliases, cache parsing and concurrent requests.

### Install or update

Download **`universal-captions-3.0.0.mpp`** or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Patch a clean **YouTube 21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK and select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages**.

**Important for 2.1.0 users:** 3.0 has its own translated-caption pen and Auto-translate hooks. Do **not** apply it alongside an older Morphe **Captions** patch that already supplies those same hooks. Use the standalone Universal Captions patch until the old Morphe implementation is replaced. Repatch YouTube after updating; updating a patch source alone doesn't update an installed APK.

### Testing and limits

Both listed YouTube versions were patched and tested manually during development. The previously limited menu on YouTube 21.20.405 expanded from 17 to 156 choices, and the user confirmed that selecting Turkish showed actual translated captions. The later dev builds, including the parser-scoped styling refactor, were tested without reported problems. Automated regression tests and Android bundle checks passed.

A visible language choice is not a guarantee that YouTube's backend will translate that particular video. The patch also doesn't replace YouTube/Morphe's caption preference or visibility settings, and exact handling of every manually selected source remains subject to the native player.

The release contains the MPP bundle, generated `patches-list.json` and its SHA-256 checksum. No modified YouTube APKs or private device logs are distributed.

Universal Captions is an independent project I developed and maintain. The Morphe maintainers later invited me to integrate it into their patch set.

See [NOTICE](https://github.com/itolkien/universal-captions/blob/main/NOTICE) for the applicable copyright and license notices.

Restores missing YouTube Auto-translate menus and expands language coverage using YouTube's per-video metadata.

### Changes
- Restore the native Auto-translate option when valid original captions exist but Android returns an empty translation list.
- Support ASR, uploaded/manual and named captions, including multiple current-audio sources.
- Read target languages dynamically; use the dated 156-language fallback only when native metadata is empty. Preserve regional menu targets.
- Preserve signed source URLs and Morphe's caption preference, Off and manual-selection policies. Existing native menus respect Morphe's additional-language setting.

### Installation
Import `universal-captions-2.1.0.mpp` or refresh this repository in Morphe Manager. Select **Universal Captions - additional translation languages** alongside **Captions**, using a clean YouTube **21.20.405** or **21.41.525** APK. Replace older experimental Universal Captions imports; select only one version. Repatch YouTube to apply the update.

### Validation
The runtime is byte-for-byte identical to device-tested experiment.4. The user reported successful translation, Off/on, audio/source changes and video switching on 21.20.405; the app-process capture showed no crash. Automated construction checks cover 193,440 source/target/locale cases. The full 45-test native-combined suite passed again, and the exact stable MPP passed Android patching/DEX/hierarchy/signing verification on both declared APK versions. Native coexistence in both orders was validated with the identical experimental implementation.

Additional user-reported device testing confirmed working operation across YouTube **20.21.37–21.42.241**, including both endpoints and intermediate versions. Automated APK validation covers **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**.

### Known limits
YouTube may withhold a translation for particular videos/accounts. Native automatic regional preference matching may choose generic `pt` for `pt-PT`; manual menu options remain separate. The fallback uses the current-audio default/native order and does not guarantee tracking every manual source choice.

Universal Captions 2.0.0 expands YouTube’s native Auto-translate language menu and sorts it by localized display name.

- Adds all languages supported by the patch to YouTube’s native Auto-translate menu, while retaining native entries.
- Caption preferences, source selection, visibility and Off behavior are managed by Morphe’s **Captions** patch.
- When the native Morphe additional-language feature is present, its setting controls the menu; the standalone addon leaves that behavior to Morphe.
- Older Morphe builds continue to use the independent language-menu extension.

**Upgrading from 1.4:** version 2.0 is a menu-only addon. Enable Morphe’s **Captions** patch for caption preference and visibility features. Use only one Universal Captions version in each patching session.

**Validated APK targets:** YouTube **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**. All 20 regression tests passed, and standalone and combined-native APKs passed SDK verification on both targets. The release implementation was also confirmed working on-device. Other versions remain unverified; translation availability varies by video and account.

**Install:** update this source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-2.0.0.mpp` from the assets below.

[Add source](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=itolkien%2Fmorphe-universal-captions&name=Universal%20Captions) · [Native Morphe integration (merged)](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/3754)

YouTube-native captions in your preferred language, with remembered language selection and an alphabetical Auto-translate menu.

- YouTube **21.41.525** and **21.20.405** compatibility.
- A curated translation-language catalogue, including Greek, with native entries retained.
- Language choices ordered by their displayed names using the app locale.
- Manual/ASR caption preference and YouTube-native translation when a suitable source is available.
- Remembered language and explicit Off preferences.

**Install:** add this repository as a source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-1.4.0.mpp`. Replace development-source copies with the release source before patching a clean supported APK.

Validated with automated regression tests, standalone APK patching/rebuilding, and user testing on Waydroid / Android 13. Translation availability varies by video and account; other YouTube versions are unverified. No modified YouTube APK is distributed.

Adds native auto-translation language options and remembers subtitle language or Off across videos. Prefers target-language manual captions, then ASR; otherwise selects a suitable native track for YouTube translation. Tested on YouTube 21.20.405 with Waydroid; other versions and edge cases unverified. No external translation API.

Experimental YouTube-native auto-translation unlock. Verified by a user on YouTube 21.20.405. Supports additional languages through native caption-track cloning. Compatibility metadata targets YouTube, not universal apps. Always retain a working APK backup; other YouTube versions are unverified.

Pdb (pdb.app) patches — power-user build.

**In-screen, not just a menu**
- **Profile IDs everywhere** — every name in the app (Soul cards, chat list, chat header, profiles) is followed by the account ID.
- **Floating power button** on every Pdb screen: ID toggle, read receipts, pause patches, copy my ID, copy last-viewed profile, open Extras.

- **No profile-visitor limit** — removes the 3-visits-per-hour cap and the "take a break" sheet.

## Pdb Extras v0.2.0

Power-user release for **Pdb: Personality & Friends** (`pdb.app` 2.134.6).

### Fixes in this release
- **Launcher icon restored** — the base APK ships an adaptive icon with a null
  foreground (the real icon normally comes from a runtime-enabled theme alias).
  The patch now points the default icon at the app's own brand glyph.
- **Startup crash fixed** — Crashlytics registrars are kept registered (Pdb's
  `Application.onCreate` requires them) while crash/analytics collection is
  disabled via the official Firebase opt-out meta-data.
- **Metadata fixed** — the bundle asset, `patches-bundle.json` download URL and
  the project version now all agree (`0.2.0`).

### Bundle
- `patches-0.2.0.mpp` — 8 patches for `pdb.app` 2.134.6 (versionCode 2694):
  standalone install, PairIP bypass, tracker shutdown, app-icon fix, Pdb Extras
  menu + resources, ad removal, Pro unlock.

### Notes
- Pdb is ARM-only; on x86_64 emulators the app needs the arm64 `libmmkv` workaround.
- Google Sign-In cannot work on a re-signed APK (GMS validates the SHA-1).
